Reinforced Chamber #33 is currently being set up to be able to hold the thaumaturgical weight of this ritual. The Confraternity, despite their initial skepticism, were convinced to hand over some of their relics stored under the Holy See. The project is going well, for now. The hard part will be the Tigris' tail. For now, we have collected the following list of materials for the ritual: * The first left molar of Saint Nicholas of Bari; * One hair of Mary Magdalene; * The left ring finger of Saint John the Baptist; * Two large slabs of holystone, measuring 30 cm x 70 cm x 20 cm each; * 500 ml of arterial blood from a juvenile //Ovis aries// (lamb); * 15 branches of //Olea europaea// (olive tree) of various dimensions; * One live //Columba leuconota// (snow pigeon); * One six-keyed double flageolet; * One timpanus with two swings; * One alto saxophone; * One bassoon. Each one of these objects and musical instruments will have to resonate in the room along with the Tigris' tail through a teurgical incantation that the undersigned, me, will deal with. The ritual will generate an estimated 96.4 Akiva, which will align the Chamber with the Communication Route to the Seventh Sky. On ██/██/20██ a new wave of attacks involving SCP-250-IT forced the project to stop for one week in order to focus on its containment. 21 civilian casualties have been recorded. A few weeks after the decifration of most of the tome, a joint force of Foundation and Confraternity personnel took off to the Dead Sea, where the portal to the dimension-wood of Bei Ilai is located. The operation was named "Samson". > **__Log of Operation Samson__** > > **Location**: 15 km from Machaerus, Dead Sea, Jordan. > **Deployed forces**: MTF-III, MTF-IV, MTF-XIII; "Richelieu" regiment of the Confraternity of Saint George's Knights. > > **Premise**: The goal of this operation is the termination of the entity known as "Tigris" in the available literature and the recovery of its skeletal tail. The order given to MTF-XIII and MTF-IV is to chase and attack the creature to overstrain it and conduct it to an area set up earlier, where the "Richelieu" regiment will inflict the final blow using one of their relics. MTF-III has the task to offer aerial and ground support. > > **Referring personnel**: S5-9; Captain Stefano Severini (MTF-XIII); Commander Francesco Cappelli (CCSG). > > **Approved equipment**: 2 Leonardo AW129 Mangusta attack helicopters; 2 VBM Freccia armoured vehicles; one OTO-Melara B1 Centauro II armoured tank destroyer. > ----- > //Log Start// > > **Agt. Cecchini**: Command, do you copy? Maria Chiara Cecchini from MTF-XIII here. We're in one of the Freccia. We're getting into the Bei Ilai woods. > > **Command**: Copy that, agent Cecchini. Is the rest of the personnel ready? > > **Cpt. Draghi**: Teams α and β of MTF-IV in position in the second Freccia. > > **Lt. Giacomelli**: Mangusta 1 and 2 ready hovering over the area. > > **Agt. Ferri**: Centauro ready, too! > > **Command**: Perfect; we inform you that the Richelieu is operative and they're setting up their position in the woods. You'll get their position on your GPS along with other units in a few seconds. The hunt may start now. > > //Ground units penetrate into the woods, scanning the perimeter in search of the entity. 25 minutes of radio silence pass.// > > **Agt. Curteni**: Christ, look at that! It's massive! //(Pointing at a deer of enormous size. Its withers height is estimated to be 4.5 metres.)// > > **Agt. Cecchini**: That's the Keresh I've told you about during briefing, stay focused on driving, Sam. > > **Agt. Curteni**: You mean the other inhabitant of the wood? > > **Agt. Cecchini**: Yeah, it's harmless. Again, Sam, pay attention to the wheel, damn it. > > **Lt. Mattei**: Keep calm, people. No need for more tension than we already have. > > **Agt. Cecchini**: Yessir, sorry sir. > > //After 15 minutes more, the first sighting is registered. A lion of white pigmentation, sized 5 metres in height and 8 metres in length, appears on the video log of the Centauro unit.// > > **Agt. Ferri**: Command, Centauro here! We've found it, it's incredible! > > **Command**: Everyone, converge on Centauro's position. You are ordered to wear soundproof headwear and safety belts as per protocol. From now on, every comm, even trivial ones, must be received via radio. > > **Agt. Cecchini**: Okay guys, let's go. Without that headwear we'd be dead at its first roar. > > **Agt. Delverde**: So are we hunting a demigod? > > **Agt. Cecchini**: Kind of: It's a Nephilim, son of a sin older than the pyramids. These creatures are born from the coupling between fallen angels and human. Poor beast... > > **Agt. Delverde**: Oh, look at it... So, what do we do now again? > > **Lt. Mattei**: You'll have to shoot at it, Laura. If we manage to convince it that there are many of us, we can direct it where we want while it flees. > > //Almost in unison, ground units start bombarding the entity. it, as thought, hasn't received any damage and turns to them, annoyed.// > > **Command**: Mangusta units, now's your turn. > > //The attack helicopters open fire on the entity and in front of it. The lion then gets scared and starts fleeing at a high speed.// > > **Command**: Ground units, follow it while maintaining formation. Freccia One on its right, Freccia two on its left and Centauro right after. Mangusta, keep following them. Maximum speed and keep firing on the objective. > > //The operation proceeds as planned; 50 minutes pass during the chase. The entity becomes more and more strained.// > > **Commander Cappelli (CCSG)**: Richelieu here, we're set up and ready to strike. You can take the nephilim towards our location. > > **Command**: Got it. Ground units, proceed. > > **Agt. Curteni**: But why is the confraternity to deal with the relic and the decisive part? Like, isn't the operation ours? > > **Lt. Mattei** They're the ones who already know how to use it. And, you know, they have a kind of rilvarly between their divisions inside the Confraternity. The Richelieu wants to keep up their standard. //(Shouting)// Watch out! > > //The Tigris' paw almost hits unit Freccia One.// > > **Lt. Mattei**: Shit! That was close! Oh, there's the regiment! > > //Richelieu's knight are visible in position a hundred metres forward. A metal structure keeps a shiny pole with a large peak made of gold and silver in place.// > > **Agt. Curteni**: Woah! What the hell is that?! > > **Lt. Mattei**: That's Saint George's spear, Sam! > > //The entity, focused on the chasing units, throws its chest onto the spear. This pierces it right between its ribs. Right before falling on the ground the entity lets out a strong roar, which throws some of the knights into the air and flips unit Freccia One over. Moreover, unit Mangusta Two suffers a malfunctioning due to the roar and is forced to crash-land. No heavily injured personnel has been recorded. The relief efforts have  ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎   safely occ  ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  urred without    ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  any com   ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  cation.// @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ [[=]] [[size 300%]] + נפילים [[/size]] [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ ##grey|That's Saint George's spear, Sam!## Uhh... What now...? ##grey|That's Saint George's spear, Sam!## My... Head hurts... ##grey|That's Saint George's spear, Sam!## Oh, not again! @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ I think... I'm in middle school again. All my old classmates are there. They're at the classroom door. I'm holding a crutch given by the hospital instead of my usual cane. Everyone's looking at me. I'm home. There's my mum that's about to take me to the doctor. "Mrs, your daughter is very lucky. It isn't a bad case, we can cure her but I fear her legs will be affected." I'm lucky. How is this luck? Everyone looks at me when I enter a room. Everyone looks at me when I walk like a crooked puppet. Everyone looks at me with a sad face, like I need help or something. People give their seat to me on the bus. I smile, because they're being kind. But I don't feel good. @@@@ @@@@ I'm in my office at the Foundation. Ninth is talking to me about a project to help with the containment of SCP-250-IT. He wants me to head it. He's not looking at my cane, nor at my stance. I accept the responsibilty, no matter the price. I can do it. I //have to//. Ninth has vanished. My cane has vanished. I can't stand up without it. I'm going to fall. In its place I have a two-five-zero instance in my hand. ++++ It's about to go off. @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ [[=]] [[image https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a1/Samson_and_the_Lion_detail_Verdun_altar.jpg/640px-Samson_and_the_Lion_detail_Verdun_altar.jpg]] [[/=]] > [[=]] > A death. > [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ ##grey|That's Saint George's spear, Sam!## The Freccia is flipped over and my head still hurts. ##grey|That's Saint George's spear, Sam!## The Tigris is on the ground. It's wetting the soil with its golden blood. ##grey|That's Saint George's spear, Sam!## Holy Christ, what have we done... > ----- > **Note**: With the death of the Tigris, as it happens with every deity, sudden catastrophic events are expected to occur in casual areas of the planet. In this case, devastating river floods and locust plagues are forecast in some of the northern areas of Syria. @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ ----- +++ Section Three: Teurgical ritual Execution The Confraternity has handed the skeletal tail of the Tigris over to Site Deus, allowing us to immediately start experimentation on the ritual. The study of the tome[[footnote]] Obviously, we did not tell the Saint George's Knights that our intel comes from a demon, or they would have never supported us with this project. [[/footnote]] took more time than expected, but I am well on track with deciphering the last formulae. [[div class="email-example"]] [[=]] [[collapsible show="Log in to SCiPNET Email? You have (1) new message!" hide="Welcome, Maria Chiara Cecchini."]] [[<]] [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** maria.chiara.cecchini@scp.net **From:** samuele.curteni@scp.net **Subject:** Big Lunchie [[/div]] ------ Hi Mari, I'm messaging you by SCiPnet since I've noticed that you can't read texts lately. I know you're very busy with Project Elohim, but I wanted to ask you anyways... Me and the others were planning to hang out all together to have sushi for lunch next week, do you think you're able to be free for one day? Lemme know, Sam P.S. I hope that this loss of energy of yours will stop at least for sushi, we miss our old cheerful Maria Chiara hahaha. [[/<]] [[/div]] [[/collapsible]] [[/=]] [[/div]] @@@@ @@@@ The Project was once again slowed by a new wave of attacks. The actions needed to contain the entities have come at a cost of €██████ and Site Deus has been in turmoil for days, keeping us from going on with our work. 26 civilian casualties have been recorded. Once the studies and preparations were completed, the focus of the Project moved onto actually executing the ritual. Log of iterations follows. > **__Log of First Level Teurgical Ritual__** > **Iteration#:** 1 > **Location**: Reinforced Chamber #33 > > **Performer**: Dr. Cecchini > **Witnesses**: S5-9, MTF-XIII > > **Goal**: Opening a Communication Route with the Empyrean dimension. > ----- > **Description**: Dr. Cecchini started the ritual by activating the first glyph, but it was not capable to emit enough Akiva radiation to activate the relics. Only the musical instruments have emitted sounds. > > **Final notes**: As expected, the first iteration was a failure. We are in the infancy of the field of teurgical rituals and we can only keep learning from every failed attempt. I will take a few minutes of rest and then back to it. > **__Log of First Level Teurgical Ritual__** > **Iteration#:** 3 > **Location**: Reinforced Chamber #33 > > **Performer**: Dr. Cecchini > **Witnesses**: S5-9, MTF-XIII > > **Goal**: Opening a Communication Route with the Empyrean dimension. > ----- > **Description**: The second glyph emitted a small quantity of radiation for a brief period of time, but still it was not enought to activate the relics. > > **Final notes**: Nothing again, but I was almost there. It is already a nice improvement but there is still so much work to do. Maybe we have to adjust the Chamber's resonance again. After the fourth attempt, Dr. Cecchini was judged too tired to keep going and was brought to her room to rest. > **__Log of First Level Teurgical Ritual__** > **Iteration#:** 6 > **Location**: Reinforced Chamber #33 > > **Performer**: Dr. Cecchini > **Witnesses**: S5-9, MTF-XIII > > **Goal**: Opening a Communication Route with the Empyrean dimension. > ----- > **Description**: Additional resonance glyphs have been applied to the Chamber's walls. This way, the ritual activation lasted 20 minutes longer and the Tigris' tail stood up, while other instruments emitted arrhytmic sounds. > > **Final notes**: It did not work this time too. I'm a bit stressed, but I can't stop here. I'll study the tome again. > **__Log of First Level Teurgical Ritual__** > **Iteration#:** 11 > **Location**: Reinforced Chamber #33 > > **Performer**: Dr. Cecchini > **Witnesses**: S5-9, MTF-XIII > > **Goal**: Opening a Communication Route with the Empyrean dimension. > ----- > **Description**: The ritual was performed using a different positioning for the relics. This made it 5 minutes longer, but no other changes were observed. The iteration was not successful. > > **Final notes**: Sure, it was obvious that the problem was not with the positioning order. How did I come up with this stupid idea? Maybe it's me who is that stupid? > **__Log of First Level Teurgical Ritual__** > **Iteration#:** 18 > **Location**: Reinforced Chamber #33 > > **Performer**: Dr. Cecchini > **Witnesses**: S5-9, MTF-XIII > > **Goal**: Opening a Communication Route with the Empyrean dimension. > ----- > **Description**: The slabs of holystone have emitted more Akiva radiation than usual, involving all the relics in the harmony besides from the Tigris' tail. This event has not permitted the activation of the ritual. > > **Final notes**: Yeah, the only explanation is that I am really that stupid. What if the tome is wrong? The more I fail, the more people die. This morning another one of those cans opened in a public park. 12 dead, shit. Despite the efforts of the personnel to persuade her to stop, Dr. Cecchini is determined to keep the Project going and finish the ritual. She constantly says that the reason is the recurring news about SCP-250-IT events across the country. > **__Log of First Level Teurgical Ritual__** > **Iteration#:** 23 > **Location**: Reinforced Chamber #33 > > **Performer**: Dr. Cecchini > **Witnesses**: S5-9, MTF-XIII > > **Goal**: Opening a Communication Route with the Empyrean dimension. > ----- > **Description**: The ritual was brought back to the original setting, leaving only the resonance glyphs that were initially added. This time the ritual was wrongly activated, allowing the relics to produce a cacophony that, if Dr. Cecchini had not stopped it in time, would have destroyed the Tigris' tail. > > **Final notes:** Fuck this shit. Fuck this shit fuck this shit fuck this shit. @@@@ @@@@ [[div class="email-example"]] [[=]] [[collapsible show="Log in to SCiPNET Email? You have (2) new messages!" hide="Welcome, Maria Chiara Cecchini."]] [[<]] [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** maria.chiara.cecchini@scp.net **From:** laura.delverde@scp.net **Subject:** Reassurance [[/div]] ------ Mari, I'm so sorry about what happened today. You can text me whenever you want after you recover. They've put a weight so heavy on you from the start... Between the Project and the explosions of 250, yours was just a genuine reaction. Please, I know these are hard times, but don't start believing you've made yourself look bad in front of us. I want you to remember that it was you, Mari, that told me to smile more first... So, please try to use your own advice. And please, let's have a girls only hang out when all of this will end. So much time has passed since the last one... Yours, Laura [[/<]] [[/div]] [[<]] [[div class="email"]] [[div class="tofrom"]] **To:** maria.chiara.cecchini@scp.net **From:** edoardo.mattei@scp.net **Subject:** How are you? [[/div]] ------ Hi Mari, Actually, I wanted to text you some time ago. I saw that you were feeling down lately, with all the story of the Project and the ritual. What happened yesterday was just totally comprehensible... Anybody else would've reacted like you did after all those attempts, saw the effect that the whole thing is having on you. Please, remember you're a human and having a panic attack is something that is totally human. I don't want you to think you're "weird" or anything else just because of that. I'm sure that Ninth too knows how you've felt. I know that these messages will feel like a scolding and that you won't even try to read them for now; I know something about that. I miss your jokes, your cheerfulness, your radiant character that made everything so light. I'm saying, I'm ready to accept everything you'll ask me as your lieutenant and as your friend, as long as you need it to start smiling again. Always remember that we love you. I hope to hear from you when you'll read this. See you soon, Edoardo [[/<]] [[/div]] [[/=]] [[/div]] [[/collapsible]] @@@@ @@@@ On ██/██/20██, at 10.34 am, Dr. Cecchini entered the Reinforced Chamber #33 without noticing her staff, in order to attempt a new iteration of the teurgical ritual. Log of the event follows. > **__Log of First Level Teurgical Ritual__** > **Iteration#:** 24 > **Location**: Reinforced Chamber #33 > > **Performer**: Dr. Cecchini > **Witnesses**: N/A > > **Goal**: Opening a Communication Route with the Empyrean dimension. > ----- > **Description**: Dr. Cecchini's singing made it possible for the instruments to resonate along with the relics in a musical harmony which has liberated 97.1 Ak of radiation. This amount of energy has allowed the Tigris' tail to levitate at the centre of the ritual. Suddenly, a beam of white light pierced the ceiling right at the centre while an unknown crystal structure formed around Dr. Cecchini. Right after this, > ███████████████████████████████████████████████████████████ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ [[=]] [[size 300%]] ++ אוֹפַנִּים [[/size]] [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ ##grey|Right after this,## Aw, Again? ##grey|Right after this,## Does it mean it worked? ##grey|Right after this,## What do I do? @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ Here's my mum again. I'm walking with her along a path on the hillside. It's Spring. Everything around me is so green. Grass all around the path looks like it's shining of its own light. I was here when I was 10. I used to have Easter lunch at my grandparents' place. The path was just like this one, at a small distance from their house. I was with my mum, she was helping me to get used to the crutch. That's what she's doing right now. The air around us is so fresh. The olive trees are green enough to let my eyes rest, but not too big to cover the blue sky. The Sun shines on me and warms my forehead, taking away the cold breeze of the first days of April. My mum smiles at me, Then leaves my hand and says she'll wait for me at home. Now I can walk. Step by step. Then I lose my balance. Instead of falling, thought, my friends come and hold me. Laura, Sam and Edo. They look at me and smile. The field around us is not there anymore, now replaced by a glass cloud and by the colours of pearls and opals. Then, over there, the dark. but I'm illuminated. While I'm looking at Edo, I hear a loud noise of glass breaking. Now, between me and him there's a broken slab. His face is diffracted by the cracks. I turn to Sam and the same thing happens. He's quietly looking at me, but there's broken glass between us. I turn again to Laura and she's looking at me too,but again her face is in pieces of glass. I don't know what's happening. I'm starting to worry. > //And the angels saw Maria Chiara, and from the clouds tuned a chant:// > [[=]] > **I can help you fix that.** > [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ What? Who is it? @@@@ @@@@ > //From the pearly clouds, the angels sang:// > [[=]] > **I am someone who can hear you.** > [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ Are you... The angel? The Throne? @@@@ @@@@ > //And the angels said, singing:// > [[=]] > **I am the Throne you were trying to ask for help to for all this time. My name is Nelka'El.** > [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ Nelka'el... So it worked, at last! @@@@ @@@@ > //The angels looked at Maria Chiara and showed her Nelka'El, the great all-seeing winged wheel. It, in chorus with them, said:// > [[=]] > **Yes, you did it. They say from the Upper Skies that the time to listen to your prayers has arrived.** > [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ So... you've brought me here? May I have an audience? @@@@ @@@@ > //The angels chanted from the clouds:// > [[=]] > **There's no need for it. With all your prayers, you only have allowed for this encounter to happen. I already know why you did it and what you need. It's actually you who helped us on Earth.** > [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ Oh... Alright. So, um... //Sniff// What do I have to do? @@@@ @@@@ > //And the Angels saw Maria Chiara cry tears of liberation and, singing, they said:// > [[=]] > **Young Maria Chiara, my proposal is this: are you willing to be my voice on the planet? I will call you from the Communication Route whenever I find a sin driven by the black star. I'll tell you where to strike and you'll refer to your comrades. Will you help me again?** > [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ I... Me? I don't know if I deserve this... There's people out there who are way worthier than me... @@@@ @@@@ > //The angels sang again among the clouds:// > [[=]] > **Dear Maria, very few are the human beings who managed to reach the Empyrean while alive. As this regards My role and My duties, you meet all the requirements to obtain Our gift. It is not about what you must or can do, but about what you //want//.** > [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ Alright... I accept. I want to deal with this. I want everybody to be able to walk the streets without fear of a  terror attack! Without those cans destroying our lives! @@@@ @@@@ > //Upon hearing those words, the angels threw a loud cry of joy. Among the ones who soared their swords in the air, those who spreaded their wings and those who just cheered, the voice that united them all together spoke once again:// > [[=]] > **This is great news, Our young creature. I led your friends to you, in the reinforced chamber, in order to close the fractures in the glass. Consider this a further thanksgiving.** > [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ I... @@@@ @@@@ > [[=]] > **See you soon.** > [[/=]] @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ ##grey|Mari, wake up!## My mum is waving at me from the porch on my grandparents' yard. ##grey|Mari, Come on! Shake it off!## She's calling me at the table. ##Grey|Come on, Mari! Hey guys, she opened her eyes! Let's go, pull yourself up!## ++++ I'm coming, mum. > **Agt. Curteni**: Mari! Are you awake? How do you feel? > > //The beam of light from above irradiates the room like a Sunday morning.// > > **Dr. Cecchini**: Uh... fine, now that I'm with you guys. > > **Agt. Delverde:** Aw, look who's back on Earth. Hey, it worked. Did you speak with the angel? > > **Dr. Cecchini**: Yes, it spoke to me... In a language made of memories. > > **Lt. Mattei**: How wonderful... So it accepted, I guess. Has it already told you something? > > **Dr. Cecchini**: ...They left the first message. "Siena, Piazza del Campo". > ----- > **Final notes**: Dr. Cecchini has been temporarily classified as a member of Class-E personnel for a period of two weeks. No physical or psychological damage was recorded. However, the appearance of mild psionic abilities linked to Reinforced Chamber #33 have been noted, e.g. the appearance of a faint but persistent field of Akiva radiation amounting to 26 cAk/s. Dr. Cecchini is the only human being who is able to interact with the aforementioned Communication Route. @@@@ @@@@ @@@@ [[=]] [[image https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/82/%D0%9D%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%89%D1%96_%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%82%D1%96_%D0%B6%D0%B8%D1%82%D1%82%D1%8F.jpg/640px-%D0%9D%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BA%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%89%D1%96_%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%82%D1%96_%D0%B6%D0%B8%D1%82%D1%82%D1%8F.jpg]] > [*https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tO7Pmx_T7fY&t=743s A rebirth.] [[/=]] [[div class="footer-wikiwalk-nav"]] [[=]] << [[[SCP-249-IT]]] | SCP-250-IT | [[[SCP-251-IT]]] >> [[/=]] [[/div]] [[include :scp-wiki:component:license-box]] > Title: Ageres.jpg > Author: Samuel Liddell MacGregor Mathers > License: Dominio pubblico > Source file: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/79/Ageres.jpg/640px-Ageres.jpg > Title: Red fire flames in dark smoke of forest fire.jpg > Author: Murphy Karen, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service > Changes by: Just Cave > License: Dominio pubblico > Source file: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a3/Red_fire_flames_in_dark_smoke_of_forest_fire.jpg/640px-Red_fire_flames_in_dark_smoke_of_forest_fire.jpg > Title: Enfer (attr. CAPTURE REPORT, LOG 424-B: FILE #424-1

SCP-424 was discovered accidentally in early 2004 at a Mohawk gas station in Campbell River, British Columbia, where it had assumed the shape of an on-shift employee, donned a reflective vest, and had begun operating the gas pumps. After allowing it to do so for approximately four hours, the manager of the station placed a call to local authorities, and the case was forwarded to covert operatives [INSUFFICIENT SECURITY CLEARANCE] and Cornwell.

—

OPERATIVE [INSUFFICIENT SECURITY CLEARANCE] DEBRIEFING [EXCERPT]: FILE #424-2

"We chased it down this alley, and it just disappeared into thin air. I look over at Cornwell to ask him if he saw anything, and he's white as a sheet. I ask him if he's okay, and he points back the way we came. I figured that he’s pointing which way he saw it go, so I make tracks out of the place, and then out of nowhere I run headlong into Cornwell, who's apparently surprised that I am where I am, as I had somehow just pointed him in the direction of the thing's escape. Long story short; yes, we did have some difficulty 'procuring the object of interest.'"

—

TRANSPORT MATERIALS REQUISITION RECORD: FILE #424-3

Storage van; cleaning company decals

Aquarium, 56 litre (sealed), 1

Portable DVD player, 1

DVD; “Un Jardin Public”, 1

Hand dolly (two-wheeled), 1

Shirt; “Tie-Dye” design, 4

—

RESIDENT STAFF COMPLAINTS (CONFIDENTIAL): FILE #424-4

"I walked into the staff restroom, and that thing followed me in, so I asked it to leave. I thought it had gone. I was facing the urinal, and it walked up to the next one over and started impersonating me. I asked it to leave again and it just smiled at me. Found it impossible to urinate while it was watching. Requesting more strict level of containment."

-Dr. Dallamore

"I left my laboratory this morning to discover that not only had the door to the reagent storage room been locked, but a duplicate of the door itself had appeared across the hallway, complete in every way save for the lack of the mandated green stripe painted on the original. Requesting more strict level of containment."

-Dr. Dallamore

"It took the shape of my mattress. Refuse to elaborate. Requesting more strict level of containment."

-Dr. Dallamore

"While writing a letter of complaint about SCP-424, my stationery crawled off of the table and under a door. I give up. Requesting change of quarters, or reassignment to another facility, in a different country.”

-Dr. Dallamore

“I think 424 is getting smarter. While writing up the results of a nonessential experiment, the words I’d written with my (now standard) rainbow-cased pen began to rearrange themselves. The little bastard had crawled right in and replaced the ink. I have to admit, though, it was quite amusing. Think I’m going to teach it to play Pictionary next week.”

-Dr. Montgomery

audio-transcript-2400-2700-anborough-xya.raw_content:
Detailed below is a communication between Site-59 Director Charles Anborough and SCP-2400 Temporal Anomalies Adviser Thaddeus Xyank describing an urgent proposal regarding containment of SCP-2700.

Xyank: You're fucking crazy.

Anborough: Good morning.

Xyank: You-are-insane.

Anborough: What you're saying has been hypothesized, tested, and proven, and is therefore boring. My proposal, on the other hand-

Xyank: No, shut up for a moment. This is stupid, deranged, and it's going to destroy the universe.

Anborough: You're calling my experiments stupid? Also, destroy the universe? Do you want me to print you a copy of my daily schedule?

Xyank: So help me, Chuck-

Anborough: It's going to work, Thad. It will work.

Xyank: So you figured out what went wrong when Tesla made 2700, that's great, but you can't fix it.

Anborough: Why not?

Xyank: You can't disassemble the machine.

Anborough: 2700 can be converted into another TAER, it just-

Xyank: You can't disassemble the machine. The moment you do, you'll breach 2700-Omega, and we're on our merry way to YK town.

Anborough: If it's done precisely, that won't happen.

Xyank: One mistake, one tiny, minuscule error, and we're screwed. There's no way we can be that precise.

Anborough: We can increase the safety margin, though. The central components of 2700-3 have causal immunity to the temporal effects of Omega, we reconstructed that causal immunity with the TAER-

Xyank: That's spectacular, we don't know how we did that.

Anborough: But we know we can. If we could establish the same kind of causal immunity, on a larger scale, around the whole device, we could-

Xyank: We don't have enough material to make a causal shell of that size.

Anborough: There are other ways to reach that result.

Xyank: …What do you mean?

Anborough: I need one of your temporal sinks.

Xyank: You can't be serious.

Anborough: It would give us enough of a buffer to complete the process with reasonable safety. Come to think of it, didn't you finish development of the XACTS at 64T? I know you used data from 2400's dilation to perfect it…

Xyank: …Okay, first of all, you'd need at least four XACTS, arranged in a pyramidal orientation and centered around 2700-3, but…

Anborough: But?

Xyank: You think Overwatch is going to go for this? It might work, but without some kind of test that doesn't involve jeopardizing the universe, they're never going to approve.

Anborough: Let's do that, then.

Xyank: …What?

Anborough: We'll test it.

Xyank: And how the hell are we going to do that?

Anborough: Well, we didn't only figure out how to turn 2700 into the TAER…we also know how to do the reverse.

Xyank: …Chuck, are you actually suggesting what I think-

Anborough: All the pieces are already sitting inside 2400. We'll put in the sinks, close the door, then put everything together and take it apart again. Thad, we're going to make another 2700.

Proposal 2400-2700 Thaumiel-Ω is currently pending O5 approval.

aumento-de-eficiencia.raw_content:
12/02/███
To the O5 Council:
I have the pleasure to inform you that I, Dr. Franklin M. Mercy, Director of Site █████, have augmented the efficiency of the site under my responsibility up to a 80%, all thanks to the use of SCP-█████, and I must thank you for giving me the opportunity to give a practical use to this artifact.

Like you already know, SCP-████ is capable of creating a variety of machines based on commands introduced in the keyboard embeded to it. We initially used these machines for tasks such as cleaning, maintenance and termination of Class-D personnel. But now the site under my watch is almost completely automated, with only two personnel left that aren't machinery, myself and Jim █████.
I've had to keep him because of the automaton's incapacity to write reports, we're still searching for a solution to this. It has been demonstrated again and again that the machines generated by SCP-████ are much more efficient that any personnel recruited by the Foundation. In my opinion, I would recommend the use of SCP-████ to the directors of all sites to generate additional personnel. It's efficient, fast, uses low resources and unlike SCP-222, it won't cause an incident of rebellion or internal conflicts. Effectively, gentlemen, the machines that SCP-████ creates are 100% loyal to the purpose of their creation, and would never do anything to harm the Foundation. They'll only continue to improve the functioning of the site.

They'll upgrade themselves after every failure, although I've seen that some of them keep exploding without apparent reason. But those are just details. Basically: SCP-████ is a great asset to the Foundation and I would recommend its use immediately.1

Dr. Franklin Morris Mercy,
Director of Site-████

Footnotes
1. SUPERIOR EFFICIENCY

The following is extended documentation regarding the infiltration of the Foundation by SCP-103-J. Any personnel who identify SCP-103-J-2 in an anomaly must document the instance photographically, highlight the instance(s) for ease of viewing, and append the documentation to this page.

●●-●●●●●-●●-● 💬 ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 👀 😭 💔

SCP-103-J is most likely responsible for the invention of noses. It's the only explanation.

Instances of SCP-2875-A confirmed to be agents of SCP-103-J. Full ramifications of this are unknown.

In light of recent discoveries, personnel are now advised to terminate potential victims of SCP-106.

Oh come on! They're not even trying to be subtle about it anymore.

Note that this particular instance of SCP-103-J-2 is inverted, making it resemble a goat's head. This is thought to be evidence of Baphomet worship by SCP-049.

SCP-902 is believed to contain an instance of SCP-103-J-2, which is causing the 'ticking' sound heard by personnel. Don't open it, that's what it wants. Open it, it needs you to.

SCP-2747 is confirmed to be an anti-Radiohead plot by SCP-103-J.

Dr. Bright is currently being brought into interrogation, to discover if he is aware of SCP-963's link to SCP-103-J

It was the unanimous opinion of the Illumination Intelligence Inc. that the keys protecting SCP-001 have been tampered with by SCP-103-J.

containment-sector-725-ko.creator: fluxman
containment-sector-725-ko.raw_content:
• Overview
  • Map
  • Facility Management
  • SCP-725-KO Management
  • Regular Deer Management

Overview

  • Founded: 08/04/2017
  • Located: Gyorae-ri, Jocheon-eup, Jeju-si, Jeju-do
  • Size: Total area approx. 2,100 m2

725-KO Containment Sector is built to ensure stable containment and research of SCP-725-KO. The said anomaly is difficult to contain as it can travel through time. Therefore, the facility is built to minimise the stress and threat the SCP instances feel while confined in an artificial environment.

The sector encapsulates part of the outer area of Halla National park. Its border is lined with natural objects such as boulders and trees, and the environment inside is to be modified at a minimum. Thanks to these efforts, the area blends seamlessly into the surrounding woods in aerial photography. Civilian access to the area is prohibited, which aides in hiding the area from the public.

Sector 725-KO focuses on containment and care for SCP-725-KO and other non-anomalous fallow deer. However, the area can be used for containment of other new anomalous objects or SCP-objects when needed.

Map





A Main gate
B Office
C Diagnosis center
D Indoor enclosure
1 Main enclosure area
2 Isolation enclosure area
3 Quarantine enclosure area
4 Training enclosure area
5 Cure enclosure area





Facility Management

Management of the containment sector ensures SCP-725-KO feels safe, prevents the instances from showing their anomalous traits and hides them from the public. Therefore, all human-made structures in the area are to take advantage of the natural environment as much as possible.


Outer Perimeter: The outer perimeter of the 725-KO Containment Sector is lined thick with indigenous rocks and vegetation to deter any civilian access. Gateways prone to bear entry trails are to be only opened at nighttime to draw minimal attention. After entry, they are to be swept immediately and then covered with foliage.


Inner Compound: Natural objects such as rocks and plants are to be attached to buildings inside the sector for camouflage. Buildings are to be regularly inspected for possible loss of attached materials.


Animal Enclosure: All SCP-725-KO enclosures have lower edges for better drainage. Vegetation inside the enclosures is to closely mimic the indigenous environment, except for very high trees. The high trees are there to hide the white, therefore relatively noticeable SCP-725-KO from aerial photos.

Two-metre-high fences surround enclosures with tops bent inside to prevent the fallow deers from escaping. The fences are to be inspected every day for damage such as clipped wires or slanted posts. Enclosures near the sector border are to have their fences covered with camouflage nets to hide it from unexpecting hikers.

The deers are to be sufficiently hydrated. Especially, quarantine enclosures must have their irrigation and feeding system checked regularly to prevent any breakdowns when newly acquired SCP-725-KO enters.

Fences of the quarantine enclosures are also lined with opaque materials such as wooden planks to block the inside view. Installed cameras replace all manual inside surveillance.

Management of SCP-725-KO

SCP-725-KO instances are identical to non-anomalous fallow deers. However, it can anomalously travel through time when threatened. Personnel manages instances following the set SCP-725-KO management protocols listed below to prevent the deers from escaping.


Management of newly acquired instances: Newly contained SCP-725-KO are easily startled by humans. Therefore, personnel must proceed with extreme caution when approaching new instances, as they can easily escape using their anomaly.

Red tags are attached to the left ear of tranquilised SCP-725-KO instances, then moved to quarantine enclosures according to their gender. Quarantined instances are to be fed food containing sedative agents. When cleaning quarantine enclosures, the deers are to be moved to another empty enclosure before cleaning. For this reason, at least one quarantine enclosure should be empty.

After a week of quarantine, non-anomalous fallow deers with higher affinity to humans is to be sent in to reduce hostility of SCP-725-KO instances to humans. After another week, when instances show affinity to management personnel, all deers inside the quarantine facility is moved to the main enclosure.

Newly acquired young SCP-725-KO instances before weaning are to be treated per the Management of younger instances protocol.


Common Management Protocol: personnel are to take and log DNA samples from all SCP-725-KO instances. Red labels are attached on the left ear to serve as indicators of individual instances.

Contained SCP-725-KO instances are separated according to their gender. At 9 A.M. the door to the enclosure is opened to let the deers in. The deers are free to roam around the enclosure until 6 P.M. when they return to the barn. Quarantined instances stay in a temporary shelter inside the quarantine enclosure, so they do not need to go into the barn.

For a 50kg SCP-725-KO instance, 500g ~ 800g of rehydrated solid deer feed and 1.6kg of hay is to be provided, in addition to vegetation in the enclosure which the deers can freely graze.


Management of younger instances: Young instances captured before weaning or newborn instances in the enclosure is to be raised by their mothers. However, if only the fawn is captured, or the mother abandons the fawn or dies, a doe which recently lost its fawn and friendly to humans are to take over said instance. Milk and urine of said doe are rubbed on the fawn to recognise the fawn as its own.

However, if the stated actions are not done or the doe refuses the SCP-725-KO fawn, the fawn is to be raised by personnel, as fawns are relatively less wary of humans therefore unlikely to escape.

In this case, personnel are to train the fawn to use the nursing bottle. Deer milk is to be used when possible. However, if deer milk is unavailable, 150cc of fresh cow milk, sheep milk or skimmed milk with margarine heated to 38 degrees Celcius is given six times a day. To induce defecation, rub the back, hind legs, belly, head, and posterior.

Human raised fawns are to wean when they can digest feed and plants. When they are about three months old, fawns are fed softer grass to help them adapt to what the adult deer consumes.


Management of does: SCP-725-KO does not need as much attention as the bucks, but pregnant individuals are given 110g of hydrophilic protein, 20g calcium, and 20g phosphate every day. High-protein food is provided first to the third month of pregnancy to ensure the fetus's birth and nutrition are smoothly conceived. From the fifth month of pregnancy, high-protein food supply is stopped and frequently exercised to prevent birth complications.


Management of bucks: Mature SCP-725-KO bucks often show fight with other bucks in winter when their horns fully grow. Therefore it is essential to monitor individual bucks' personalities and quarantine the most aggressive and the weakest individuals separately in the quarantine enclosures until spring, when their horns fall off, and aggression drops.


Management of older instances: Older instances have a relatively higher risk of injury or malnourishment due to attacks from younger instances and weaker bodies. They are to be quarantined and taken care individually.


Disposal of the corpse: The corpse of SCP-725-KO is to be retrieved and dissected under the supervision of 725-KO Containment Sector Research Team. The skeleton and organs are to be preserved, labelled and stored indefinitely in the office building's storage site. Induced skeletonisation of the bodies is done by burying them in the enclosure grounds. Still, when burial is unfavourable due to soil pollution concerns, the body is buried outside sector grounds, skeletonised, and taken back into the sector.


Management of dropped antlers: SCP-725-KO bucks naturally drop their antlers at springtime. They are to be retrieved, identified, and stored in the office building storage sight. When visual identification is difficult, DNA testing is to be used.

Management of non-anomalous fallow deer

The purpose of raising non-anomalous deer in 725-KO Containment Sector is to expose SCP-725-KO instances to other deers friendly to humans and reduce the hostility of SCP-725-KO instances.

Non-anomalous fallow deer captured alongside with SCP-725-KO are to be moved with the anomalous instance. When there is a lack of non-anomalous fallow deer, personnel should purchase albino fallow deer friendly to humans from external breeders.

The management of anomalous and non-anomalous fallow deer are roughly the same. The only difference is the label's colour: non-anomalous deer have yellow labels attached instead of red.

Fallow deer tend to be highly fertile in captivity. Non-anomalous deer are to separated according to their gender or castrated for population control. Crossbreeding of SCP-725-KO and non-anomalous deer is strictly prohibited.


Training newly acquired instances: Albino fallow deer lose their wild instincts: they are relatively mellower and more submissive to personnel than typical deer. However, this does not mean they do not require any subordination training.

Newly acquired non-anomalous instances are trained in the training enclosure, reducing their hostility by being fed and groomed by personnel. Instances deemed the most submissive are selected to be used for training of SCP-725-KO instances in quarantine.

Also, personnel are to hand-feed and groom non-anomalous deer in front of SCP-725-KO in the main enclosure. This helps the anomalous instances to acknowledge that Foundation personnel are not a threat. Such procedures are to be practised weekly.

disseminated-documentation-1985-alpha.raw_content:
This document contains a partial archive of excursions undertaken by SCP-1985. Format is as follows:

  • Excursion Label
  • Priming: (success/failure)
  • Trigger:
  • Equipment/Personnel:
  • Reality Description:
  • Logs: ([FORTHCOMING] if awaiting release, [RESTRICTED] if not)
  • Retrieval:
  • Retrieved Items:
  • Notes:

Full information may be restricted to members of Special Access Program "Cantilevered Muskrat".

Excursion 310-DJ4-9LK
Priming: SCP-765 (success)
Trigger: Standard lethal injection
Equipment: Standard
Reality Description: SCP-1985 initially arrived in the core of an active volcano and expired. Excursion was repeated.
Individuals associated with The Serpent's Hand had triggered an AK-class end of the world scenario utilizing SCP-765 in combination with an unknown effect-amplifier after the alternate reality's Foundation had decided to expand its size by 1000% for unknown reasons. 90% of the world's population was afflicted with crippling lethargy, apathy, boredom, and depression, causing vast numbers to die of starvation, and sometimes dehydration, as they ceased to eat or drink respectively. SCP-1985 was unfortunately not immune to this effect, and died of starvation after several months.
Logs: [RESTRICTED]
Retrieval: Uneventful. SCP-1985 expressed intense relief at being free of SCP-765's effect.
Retrieved Items: A canister of water from the modified SCP-765, collected before SCP-1985 succumbed to the effect.
Notes: This was intended to test to see if SCP-1985 would find a reality undergoing a K-Class scenario related to the safest of Safe-class SCPs.

Excursion 17V-MNU-094
Priming: [REDACTED], a Foundation-contained anomalous object with qualities similar to Pied Piper folk mythology (success).
[File revision: Identifying item number redacted due to administrative abuse concerns following standard RAISA procedures. File currently under review.]
Trigger: Standard lethal injection
Equipment: Standard
Reality Description: [REDACTED] was stolen from the Foundation by members of the Chaos Insurgency, who used it to control several million animals and children in the continental United States, first using them to extract political concessions, then using them as a makeshift army, then eventually slaughtering most of them. No alteration to [REDACTED] was apparently required to achieve this effect.
Notably, during this excursion, SCP-1985 encountered what appeared to be an alternate version of itself, also in excursion form with similar visual traits, and completely missing both arms. This alternate version of SCP-1985 fled on sight, and SCP-1985 was unable to relocate it. SCP-1985 was killed by the Chaos Insurgency after two weeks.
Logs: [FORTHCOMING]
Retrieval: Uneventful
Retrieved Items: None.
Notes: It is not known if this reality's version of [REDACTED] possesses the same capabilities that its alternate demonstrated during this excursion.
File Update: This older excursion entry, among others, are under review for administrative abuse of access to SCP-1985's priority request backlog, and misuse of SCP-1985 to explore abusive applications of Foundation-contained anomalous items.

Excursion 051-UWJ-97Y
Priming: SCP-1157 (success)
Trigger: Standard lethal injection
Equipment: Standard
Reality Description: SK-class dominance shift scenario in which instances of SCP-1157 had become the dominant species of Earth. Baseline humans made up a significant minority, with the majority of their population having been killed. Instances of SCP-1157 controlled most major countries, though humans still controlled a minority. The Foundation was still present and containing the majority of extant SCP items, and many SCP-1157 instances were working with the Foundation and the remnants of the Global Occult Coalition to attempt to reverse the SK-class scenario. Additionally, not all SCP-1157 instances were identical to SCP-1157-1; sixteen different base forms were observed, each represented by a different collective consciousness. [DATA EXPUNGED]
Logs: [FORTHCOMING]
Retrieval: Uneventful.
Retrieved Items: [DATA EXPUNGED]
Notes: Remainder of excursion details, including nature of retrieved items, are currently classified Level 5.

Excursion 1FR-L75-03X
Priming: [REDACTED], a Foundation-contained anomalous object with anomalous capabilities related to depicting unusual sexual behavior. Notable Foundation members claimed the object also produced those desires and used this to justify predatory behavior.
[File revision: Identifying item number redacted due to administrative abuse concerns following standard RAISA procedures. File currently under review.]
Trigger: Standard lethal injection
Equipment: Standard
Reality Description: Mass broadcast and distribution of [REDACTED] by associates of [DATA EXPUNGED] resulted in an AK-class end of the world scenario in which 94% of the global population exhibited behavior characteristic of [DATA EXPUNGED]. The Foundation survived in this reality, and efforts to reverse [REDACTED]'s effects were ongoing. Notably, this reality's Foundation believed the object was (contra at the time current reports) to be incapable of producing this behavior at baseline, and [DATA EXPUNGED] induced the end of the world scenario deliberately to justify a theocratic social takeover, before losing control over the process. Reversal initiatives were in early-stage implementation and [DATA EXPUNGED]
Logs: [RESTRICTED]
Retrieval: Uneventful
Retrieved Items: None.
Notes: Request was made by Dr. ██████, to investigate the possible seriousness of [REDACTED]'s effects.
File Update: This older excursion entry, among others, are under review for administrative abuse of access to SCP-1985's priority request backlog, and misuse of SCP-1985 to explore abusive applications of Foundation-contained anomalous items, as well as constituting personal abuse of SCP-1985 directly.

Excursion NIN-100-RC3
Priming: None
Trigger: SCP-1985 was caught in crossfire during a Chaos Insurgency incursion during a move between sites, sustaining injuries to its left leg. SCP-1985 acquired a weapon and fatally shot itself.
Equipment: None except for inbuilt recording equipment
Reality Description: [EXPUNGED DATA PENDING RELEASE] SCP-1985 was publicly tortured and killed in a group execution. Members of group included four local versions of SCP-1985's family members.
Logs: [RESTRICTED]
Retrieval: Uneventful.
Retrieved Items: [EXPUNGED DATA PENDING RELEASE]
Notes: As typical after an excursion of this nature, SCP-1985 requested temporary isolation and temporary cessation of experimentation. Request granted.

Excursion D4L-41N-K0M
Priming: Repeated exposure to SCP-3932 (success)
Trigger: Standard lethal injection
Equipment: Standard
Reality Description: Following Foundation diplomatic intervention, tensions between SCP-3932-Δ nation-states became lessened. This resulted in a temporary peace accord between the nations, who then declared war on humanity. Conversion of all oceanic cetaceans into SCP-3932-Δ instances followed shortly thereafter, with full conversion occurring three months after.
The SCP-3932-Δ instances then caused a partial SK-Class Dominance Shift Scenario, resulting in all oceans being taken over by SCP-3932-Δ instances. The original three nation-states of SCP-3932-Δ emerged as major superpowers, but were unable to retain complete control over the world.
Logs: [FORTHCOMING]
Retrieval: SCP-1985 manifested in the water off the coast of Australia, having previously been aboard an Great Barrier Reef Empire-In-Exile prison vessel. Rescue dispatched from Site-72.
Retrieved Items: None.
Notes: In this reality, the Foundation has avoided any attempt to diminish the cold war between SCP-3932-Δ nation-states, out of fear of potential alliance.

Excursion 5TY-H6I-GHR
Priming: SCP-682 and associated Termination Log (unknown)
Trigger: Standard lethal injection
Equipment: Standard, along with a [RESTRICTED LEVEL 5] stealth device
Reality Description: SCP-1985 arrived in a massive stone labyrinth consisting of hallways approximately 3.5 meters wide and 12 meters tall. The labyrinth appeared to be carved from a single seamless type of material, with no cracks observed during the entirety of SCP-1985's excursion. The lack of any observable light source required use of a Foundation-issue flashlight. SCP-1985's exploration of this reality remained uneventful until it encountered an object possessing cognitohazardous and/or unknown anomalous properties, resulting in the damage of SCP-1985's inbuilt recording and communication equipment. Remaining footage of the object was too blurry to decipher or remained cognitohazardous, but after-action report from SCP-1985 described the object as a stained-glass window, embedded into one of the walls, with light shinning through it. SCP-1985 was unable to identify the image on the window, due to fear of mind-altering effects from prolonged exposure. SCP-1985 was able to resist the cognitohazard but claims it gave it the urge to [DATA EXPUNGED].

SCP-1985 describes encountering two other anomalous objects: a red organic cube protruding out of a wall, and a large presumably mechanical object SCP-1985 observed moving across a hallway in the distance. After three days, SCP-1985 came across a large square room, with the only features being an unknown object hanging 3 meters off the ground1 and a large hole underneath it, emitting yellowish-green light and producing sawtooth beeps. SCP-1985 describes approaching the hole and looking down it, but is unable to remember what was down the hole and what happened afterward; it is presumed this led to its death as SCP-1985 manifested in baseline reality around this time.
Logs: [FORTHCOMING]
Retrieval: Uneventful
Retrieved Items: None.
Notes: This excursion was meant to be the first in a series of excursions with the goal of gaining knowledge of potential K-class scenarios caused by SCP-682 and to prepare countermeasures. Whether or not the observed reality has any relation to SCP-682 is currently under review.

Excursion TLB-13P-MM9
Priming: SCP-2186 (success)
Trigger: Standard lethal injection
Equipment/Personnel: Standard
Reality Description: This reality's Foundation was at a point in time in which SCP-148's deleterious properties were still unknown and its usage was relatively common; this Foundation had additionally created an altered form of beryllium bronze by reverse engineering SCP-148 and SCP-402. This metal functioned similarly to SCP-148, absorbing reality-altering properties instead of mind-effecting ones.

This metal was used during a surgery performed on SCP-2186, lining the surfaces of the room. Despite the application of general anesthesia, SCP-2186's properties activated in the middle of the procedure with a higher intensity than normal; stage 1 transformation occurring after 30 seconds followed by stage 2 occurring after 2 minutes. The altered metal prevented the anomaly's properties (which lasted 12 hours, preventing the object's retrieval before it expired) from extending beyond the room. Approximately 16 minutes after the object expired, the altered metal released the anomalous energy which resulted in the entirety of the Earth, everything therein, and the Moon to undergo stage 2 transformation. SCP-1985 returned to baseline reality after six months of exploring the transfigured landscape.
Logs: [FORTHCOMING]
Retrieval: Uneventful
Retrieved Items: Material samples taken from affected landscapes, objects, and organisms.
Notes: DNA analysis of 68% of retrieved samples are a direct match with SCP-2186. DNA analysis of 29% of retrieved samples have no exact genetic match to existing organisms. The results of the DNA analysis of the remaining 3% of retrieved samples is restricted, pending release.

Excursion 702-RTX-47Z
Priming: SCP-002 (success)
Trigger: Standard lethal injection
Equipment: Standard
Reality Description: SCP-002 was uncovered by this reality's foundation much earlier than its baseline counterpart, and was subjected to less restrictive experiments. During said experiments, it was cross-tested with an unknown biological anomaly, which caused the entire planet to be converted into a single living organism. SCP-1985 had arrived in New York City, where the buildings had been converted into structures of bone, flesh, and sinew, while the streets were paved with a pulsating, membranous substance that emitted rhythmic throbs. Every object that SCP-1985 encountered was made of a similar composition.

During its week-long excursion, SCP-1985 encountered a Sarkic group, who had not been converted during the transformation event. The members of the group explained to SCP-1985 that during the transformation event, they had used their flesh-crafting abilities to keep their human form and survive in the new environment. They confirmed that a majority of all life on the planet had been converted into “flesh furniture” or similar objects.
Logs: [FORTHCOMING]
Retrieval: Uneventful.
Retrieved Items: A “Globe” made of organic matter.
Notes: DNA analysis of the “Globe” reveals that various species of Animal, Plant, and Fungi, have all been forced into its shape.

Excursion V08-FXB-N25
Priming: SCP-1985's own, personal origins (failure)
Trigger: Standard lethal injection
Equipment: Standard
Reality Description: SCP-1985 initially arrived mid-Pacific Ocean and swam to shore. A full-scale SCP-1801 outbreak had converted the majority of life on the planet into a single, contiguous, fleshy mass. When SCP-1985 arrived, SCP-1801 had apparently adapted in order to begin converting inorganic material as well and was in the process of doing so. A small number of SCP Foundation personnel survived and were attempting to contain the SCP-1801 outbreak, with little success. The SCP-1801 mass attempted to convert SCP-1985 after it accidentally came into close contact with the mass, and SCP-1985 was automatically returned as normal.
Logs: [FORTHCOMING]
Retrieval: Uneventful
Retrieved Items: None.
Notes: Accidental discovery of potential extra capabilities associated with SCP-1801 has been passed on as per standard procedure.

Excursion XJU-034-IQ1
Priming: SCP-1985's own, personal origins (success)
Trigger: Standard lethal injection
Equipment: Standard
Reality Description: [DATA EXPUNGED]
Log: [N/A]
Retrieval: [DATA EXPUNGED]
Retrieved Items: [N/A]
Notes: [DATA EXPUNGED] Personnel with Level 4 clearance may access the content of this entry, attached to main SCP-1985 documentation here under the Update to Excursions section.

Footnotes
1. Due to unknown cognitohazardous/████████████ influence, SCP-1985 was unable to accurately determine the appearance of the object. SCP-1985 claimed it was either a chandelier of some type or a board with an unknown linguistic character on it.

disseminated-documentation-1985-alpha.raw_source: [[>]] [[module Rate]] [[/>]] This document contains a partial archive of excursions undertaken by [[[SCP-1985]]]. Format is as follows: * **Excursion Label** * **Priming:** (success/failure) * **Trigger:** * **Equipment/Personnel:** * **Reality Description:** * **Logs:** ([FORTHCOMING] if awaiting release, [RESTRICTED] if not) * **Retrieval:** * **Retrieved Items:** * **Notes:** Full information may be restricted to members of Special Access Program "Cantilevered Muskrat". --------- **Excursion 310-DJ4-9LK** **Priming:** [[[SCP-765]]] (success) **Trigger:** Standard lethal injection **Equipment:** Standard **Reality Description:** SCP-1985 initially arrived in the core of an active volcano and expired. Excursion was repeated. Individuals associated with The Serpent's Hand had triggered an AK-class end of the world scenario utilizing SCP-765 in combination with an unknown effect-amplifier after the alternate reality's Foundation had decided to expand its size by 1000% for unknown reasons. 90% of the world's population was afflicted with crippling lethargy, apathy, boredom, and depression, causing vast numbers to die of starvation, and sometimes dehydration, as they ceased to eat or drink respectively. SCP-1985 was unfortunately not immune to this effect, and died of starvation after several months. **Logs:** [RESTRICTED] **Retrieval:** Uneventful. SCP-1985 expressed intense relief at being free of SCP-765's effect. **Retrieved Items:** A canister of water from the modified SCP-765, collected before SCP-1985 succumbed to the effect. **Notes:** This was intended to test to see if SCP-1985 would find a reality undergoing a K-Class scenario related to the safest of Safe-class SCPs. **Excursion 17V-MNU-094** **Priming:** [REDACTED], a Foundation-contained anomalous object with qualities similar to Pied Piper folk mythology (success). //[File revision: Identifying item number redacted due to administrative abuse concerns following standard RAISA procedures. File currently under review.]// **Trigger:** Standard lethal injection **Equipment:** Standard **Reality Description:** [REDACTED] was stolen from the Foundation by members of the Chaos Insurgency, who used it to control several million animals and children in the continental United States, first using them to extract political concessions, then using them as a makeshift army, then eventually slaughtering most of them. No alteration to [REDACTED] was apparently required to achieve this effect. Notably, during this excursion, SCP-1985 encountered what appeared to be an alternate version of itself, also in excursion form with similar visual traits, and completely missing both arms. This alternate version of SCP-1985 fled on sight, and SCP-1985 was unable to relocate it. SCP-1985 was killed by the Chaos Insurgency after two weeks. **Logs:** [FORTHCOMING] **Retrieval:** Uneventful **Retrieved Items:** None. **Notes:** It is not known if this reality's version of [REDACTED] possesses the same capabilities that its alternate demonstrated during this excursion. //**File Update:** This older excursion entry, among others, are under review for administrative abuse of access to SCP-1985's priority request backlog, and misuse of SCP-1985 to explore abusive applications of Foundation-contained anomalous items.// **Excursion 051-UWJ-97Y** **Priming:** [[[SCP-1157]]] (success) **Trigger:** Standard lethal injection **Equipment:** Standard **Reality Description:** SK-class dominance shift scenario in which instances of SCP-1157 had become the dominant species of Earth. Baseline humans made up a significant minority, with the majority of their population having been killed. Instances of SCP-1157 controlled most major countries, though humans still controlled a minority. The Foundation was still present and containing the majority of extant SCP items, and many SCP-1157 instances were working with the Foundation and the remnants of the Global Occult Coalition to attempt to reverse the SK-class scenario. Additionally, not all SCP-1157 instances were identical to SCP-1157-1; sixteen different base forms were observed, each represented by a different collective consciousness. [DATA EXPUNGED] **Logs:** [FORTHCOMING] **Retrieval:** Uneventful. **Retrieved Items:** [DATA EXPUNGED] **Notes:** Remainder of excursion details, including nature of retrieved items, are currently classified Level 5. **Excursion 1FR-L75-03X** **Priming:** [REDACTED], a Foundation-contained anomalous object with anomalous capabilities related to depicting unusual sexual behavior. Notable Foundation members claimed the object also produced those desires and used this to justify predatory behavior. //[File revision: Identifying item number redacted due to administrative abuse concerns following standard RAISA procedures. File currently under review.]// **Trigger:** Standard lethal injection **Equipment:** Standard **Reality Description:** Mass broadcast and distribution of [REDACTED] by associates of [DATA EXPUNGED] resulted in an AK-class end of the world scenario in which 94% of the global population exhibited behavior characteristic of [DATA EXPUNGED]. The Foundation survived in this reality, and efforts to reverse [REDACTED]'s effects were ongoing. Notably, this reality's Foundation believed the object was (contra at the time current reports) to be incapable of producing this behavior at baseline, and [DATA EXPUNGED] induced the end of the world scenario deliberately to justify a theocratic social takeover, before losing control over the process. Reversal initiatives were in early-stage implementation and [DATA EXPUNGED] **Logs:** [RESTRICTED] **Retrieval:** Uneventful **Retrieved Items:** None. **Notes:** Request was made by Dr. ██████, to investigate the possible seriousness of [REDACTED]'s effects. //**File Update:** This older excursion entry, among others, are under review for administrative abuse of access to SCP-1985's priority request backlog, and misuse of SCP-1985 to explore abusive applications of Foundation-contained anomalous items, as well as constituting personal abuse of SCP-1985 directly.//   **Excursion NIN-100-RC3** **Priming:** None **Trigger:** SCP-1985 was caught in crossfire during a Chaos Insurgency incursion during a move between sites, sustaining injuries to its left leg. SCP-1985 acquired a weapon and fatally shot itself. **Equipment:** None except for inbuilt recording equipment **Reality Description:** [EXPUNGED DATA PENDING RELEASE] SCP-1985 was publicly tortured and killed in a group execution. Members of group included four local versions of SCP-1985's family members. **Logs:** [RESTRICTED] **Retrieval:** Uneventful. **Retrieved Items:** [EXPUNGED DATA PENDING RELEASE] **Notes:** As typical after an excursion of this nature, SCP-1985 requested temporary isolation and temporary cessation of experimentation. Request granted. **Excursion D4L-41N-K0M** **Priming:** Repeated exposure to [[[SCP-3932]]] (success) **Trigger:** Standard lethal injection **Equipment:** Standard **Reality Description:** Following Foundation diplomatic intervention, tensions between SCP-3932-Δ nation-states became lessened. This resulted in a temporary peace accord between the nations, who then declared war on humanity. Conversion of all oceanic cetaceans into SCP-3932-Δ instances followed shortly thereafter, with full conversion occurring three months after. The SCP-3932-Δ instances then caused a partial SK-Class Dominance Shift Scenario, resulting in all oceans being taken over by SCP-3932-Δ instances. The original three nation-states of SCP-3932-Δ emerged as major superpowers, but were unable to retain complete control over the world. **Logs:** [FORTHCOMING] **Retrieval:** SCP-1985 manifested in the water off the coast of Australia, having previously been aboard an Great Barrier Reef Empire-In-Exile prison vessel. Rescue dispatched from Site-72. **Retrieved Items:** None. **Notes:** In this reality, the Foundation has avoided any attempt to diminish the cold war between SCP-3932-Δ nation-states, out of fear of potential alliance. **Excursion 5TY-H6I-GHR** **Priming:** [http://www.scp-wiki.net/scp-682 SCP-682] and associated [http://www.scp-wiki.net/experiment-log-t-98816-oc108-682 Termination Log] (unknown) **Trigger:** Standard lethal injection **Equipment:** Standard, along with a [RESTRICTED LEVEL 5] stealth device **Reality Description:** SCP-1985 arrived in a massive stone labyrinth consisting of hallways approximately 3.5 meters wide and 12 meters tall. The labyrinth appeared to be carved from a single seamless type of material, with no cracks observed during the entirety of SCP-1985's excursion. The lack of any observable light source required use of a Foundation-issue flashlight. SCP-1985's exploration of this reality remained uneventful until it encountered an object possessing cognitohazardous and/or unknown anomalous properties, resulting in the damage of SCP-1985's inbuilt recording and communication equipment. Remaining footage of the object was too blurry to decipher or remained cognitohazardous, but after-action report from SCP-1985 described the object as a stained-glass window, embedded into one of the walls, with light shinning through it. SCP-1985 was unable to identify the image on the window, due to fear of mind-altering effects from prolonged exposure. SCP-1985 was able to resist the cognitohazard but claims it gave it the urge to [DATA EXPUNGED]. SCP-1985 describes encountering two other anomalous objects: a red organic cube protruding out of a wall, and a large presumably mechanical object SCP-1985 observed moving across a hallway in the distance. After three days, SCP-1985 came across a large square room, with the only features being an unknown object hanging 3 meters off the ground[[footnote]] Due to unknown cognitohazardous/[http://scp-int.wikidot.com/scp-1184-ru ████████████] influence, SCP-1985 was unable to accurately determine the appearance of the object. SCP-1985 claimed it was either a chandelier of some type or a board with an unknown linguistic character on it.[[/footnote]] and a large hole underneath it, emitting yellowish-green light and producing sawtooth beeps. SCP-1985 describes approaching the hole and looking down it, but is unable to remember what was down the hole and what happened afterward; it is presumed this led to its death as SCP-1985 manifested in baseline reality around this time. **Logs:** [FORTHCOMING] **Retrieval:** Uneventful **Retrieved Items:** None. **Notes:** This excursion was meant to be the first in a series of excursions with the goal of gaining knowledge of potential K-class scenarios caused by SCP-682 and to prepare countermeasures. Whether or not the observed reality has any relation to SCP-682 is currently under review. **Excursion TLB-13P-MM9** **Priming:** [[[SCP-2186]]] (success) **Trigger:** Standard lethal injection **Equipment/Personnel:** Standard **Reality Description:** This reality's Foundation was at a point in time in which [[[SCP-148]]]'s deleterious properties were still unknown and its usage was relatively common; this Foundation had additionally created an altered form of beryllium bronze by reverse engineering SCP-148 and [[[SCP-402]]]. This metal functioned similarly to SCP-148, absorbing reality-altering properties instead of mind-effecting ones. This metal was used during a surgery performed on SCP-2186, lining the surfaces of the room. Despite the application of general anesthesia, SCP-2186's properties activated in the middle of the procedure with a higher intensity than normal; stage 1 transformation occurring after 30 seconds followed by stage 2 occurring after 2 minutes. The altered metal prevented the anomaly's properties (which lasted 12 hours, preventing the object's retrieval before it expired) from extending beyond the room. Approximately 16 minutes after the object expired, the altered metal released the anomalous energy which resulted in the entirety of the Earth, everything therein, and the Moon to undergo stage 2 transformation. SCP-1985 returned to baseline reality after six months of exploring the transfigured landscape. **Logs:** [FORTHCOMING] **Retrieval:** Uneventful **Retrieved Items:** Material samples taken from affected landscapes, objects, and organisms. **Notes:** DNA analysis of 68% of retrieved samples are a direct match with SCP-2186. DNA analysis of 29% of retrieved samples have no exact genetic match to existing organisms. The results of the DNA analysis of the remaining 3% of retrieved samples is restricted, pending release. **Excursion 702-RTX-47Z** **Priming:** [[[SCP-002]]] (success) **Trigger:** Standard lethal injection **Equipment:** Standard **Reality Description:** SCP-002 was uncovered by this reality's foundation much earlier than its baseline counterpart, and was subjected to less restrictive experiments. During said experiments, it was cross-tested with an unknown biological anomaly, which caused the entire planet to be converted into a single living organism. SCP-1985 had arrived in New York City, where the buildings had been converted into structures of bone, flesh, and sinew, while the streets were paved with a pulsating, membranous substance that emitted rhythmic throbs. Every object that SCP-1985 encountered was made of a similar composition. During its week-long excursion, SCP-1985 encountered a Sarkic group, who had not been converted during the transformation event. The members of the group explained to SCP-1985 that during the transformation event, they had used their flesh-crafting abilities to keep their human form and survive in the new environment. They confirmed that a majority of all life on the planet had been converted into “flesh furniture” or similar objects. **Logs:** [FORTHCOMING] **Retrieval:** Uneventful. **Retrieved Items:** A “Globe” made of organic matter. **Notes:** DNA analysis of the “Globe” reveals that various species of Animal, Plant, and Fungi, have all been forced into its shape. **Excursion V08-FXB-N25** **Priming:** SCP-1985's own, personal origins (failure) **Trigger:** Standard lethal injection **Equipment:** Standard **Reality Description:** SCP-1985 initially arrived mid-Pacific Ocean and swam to shore. A full-scale [[[SCP-1801]]] outbreak had converted the majority of life on the planet into a single, contiguous, fleshy mass. When SCP-1985 arrived, SCP-1801 had apparently adapted in order to begin converting inorganic material as well and was in the process of doing so. A small number of SCP Foundation personnel survived and were attempting to contain the SCP-1801 outbreak, with little success. The SCP-1801 mass attempted to convert SCP-1985 after it accidentally came into close contact with the mass, and SCP-1985 was automatically returned as normal. **Logs:** [FORTHCOMING] **Retrieval:** Uneventful **Retrieved Items:** None. **Notes:** Accidental discovery of potential extra capabilities associated with SCP-1801 has been passed on as per standard procedure. **Excursion XJU-034-IQ1** **Priming:** SCP-1985's own, personal origins (success) **Trigger:** Standard lethal injection **Equipment:** Standard **Reality Description:** [DATA EXPUNGED] **Log:** [N/A] **Retrieval:** [DATA EXPUNGED] **Retrieved Items:** [N/A] **Notes:** [DATA EXPUNGED] Personnel with Level 4 clearance may access the content of this entry, attached to main [[[SCP-1985]]] documentation [[[scp-1985|here]]] under the Update to Excursions section.
