Description: Subject manifested in a large auditorium containing an estimate of 50,000 identical 507 objects. Objects seemed to be having an analogue to a political rally, advocating for the overthrow of the government, under the organization name of the "People's Dimension-Hopper Republic". Within the two weeks of the duration of subject's shift, the PDHR overthrew the United States government, establishing their own government in the form of a republic entirely composed of 507 objects. Subject was elected to the office of representative of Massachusetts, and was about to introduce its first piece of legislation when subject shifted back to prime reality.

Requests: None.

812-BCF-121

Retrieval: Subject reappeared within its containment chamber, without its handgun or knife.

Description: Subject manifested in a train-like vehicle. Upon manifesting, it noticed several other individuals seated at various locations along the carriage, who did not remark upon his sudden appearance. The subject noted that the train appeared to be in some kind of black void, with nothing visible out the windows. After 30 minutes, a humanoid creature without facial features spotted the subject, and asked him for his "ticket". Upon the subject reporting his lack of tickets, he was searched, and his weapons were confiscated. The subject was told they would have to leave the train at the next stop, and they would be fined "10 minutes". The subject began to explore the train, but shifted back after walking approximately 3km and finding no end.

Requests: Replacement gear. Granted.

5H4-2KP-NCH

Retrieval: Subject appeared in its containment with multiple deep bite wounds in the forearms.

Description: Subject arrived in a facility identical to Site-██. Intercom warnings stated that "SPC-507 has displaced. If spotted, the object is to be punched immediately and returned to containment." Subject reported fearing for its safety until the alternate Dr. ███ entered its containment to reassure it that it was not the one to be “punched back into this world”. Subject stayed in containment for 3 hours before a “[EXPLETIVE] huge shark” materialized in containment with it and proceeded to attack the subject. Two guard personnel entered the subject's containment and proceeded to “punch [the shark] in its stupid shark face” multiple times.

Requests: Shark repellant. Denied on the grounds that Site-██ has no non-anomalous shark repellant.

5L3-33P-IN6

Retrieval: Subject reappeared in its containment chamber, asleep.

Description: Unknown. Subject claims to have slept through the entire shift.

Requests: A wristwatch that will detect when it has shifted and sound an alarm to wake it up if it is sleeping at the time by detecting the absence of signal pings from the site. Granted, watch currently in development.

D0N-T8L-1NK

Retrieval: Subject reappeared exactly where it had disappeared (from its seat in the Site cafeteria), a fraction of a second later. Subject did not realize it had shifted until informed of such by Agent M█████, with whom it had been speaking at the time.

Description: Unknown. Duration of shift is estimated to have been fewer than 100 milliseconds. As it occurred while SCP-507 was blinking, subject was not able to visually observe destination universe before the shift ended.

Requests: None.

5F8-13I-BBO

Retrieval: Subject appeared in the employee break room, seeming to repeatedly mutter phrases described as being about laundry detergent. Subject recovered after 5 minutes, although it proceeded to talk primarily about a non-existent product named "Reality-Cleaning Laundry Detergent" for an additional 30 minutes. Subject vocalized the inclusion of the hyphen.

Description: Subject appeared in the middle of an empty highway and immediately went to the side of the road, beginning to walk towards a city in distance. Upon arrival, subject noted that, while there were few pedestrians outside, some electronic devices were still active. Most notable of which were a variety of "retro" television sets throughout sidewalks and roads. Any pedestrians that were outside sat or lay on the ground, watching said television sets. Subject then sat down in front of one of the sets and saw an ad for "Reality-Cleaning Laundry Detergent". Purported advertisement used a substantial amount of Christian imagery. Subject shifted back after 53 minutes, unable to recall any other programming that wasn't an advertisement.

Requests: Multiple cases of "Reality-Cleaning Laundry Detergent." Multiple researchers have suggested that the subject should go through cognitohazard training in order to prevent further damage to its mental state. Proposal is pending O5 approval.

168-PRK-111

Retrieval: Subject appeared unconscious within a temporarily unoccupied containment chamber within a highly classified portion of the site, but required no amnesticization due to bodily effects sustained for a few hours following the shift.

Description: Subject appeared in a hallway in a large government facility roughly analogous to the site, but with significantly looser security. Various anomalies such as "vegetable robots" and a "lion in a toga" were observed walking around the building and even fraternizing with guards and researchers, and subject was gifted a soft woolen robe upon first being noticed by staff. All encountered persons proved extremely amiable and open, one being disappointed after subject attempted to end a conversation after nearly two hours of dialogue.

Attempts to leave the facility were fruitless as no exits or maps could be found, and questioned persons were confused at and rejected the idea of reality external to the location. The total extent of this location is unknown, as subject managed to traverse a single hallway for thirty-two miles before abandoning the route and sleeping in a cafeteria. Food in this cafeteria consisted entirely of various meat products, but was otherwise normal.

After three days, a high-pitched squeaking noise began emanating from a singular speaker in each room, after which all personnel and motile anomalies began calmly walking further along that hallway and discussing an action called "ploking" in vague and spiritual terms. After one guard briefly tripped and stopped walking, subject was told to look away, but instead asked what it means to "ploke". Upon hearing this, a humanoid with several segmented legs emerging from facial orifices asked how an individual could be unfamiliar with ploking before using its non-walking legs to form a previously unknown kinetoglyph and induce paralysis and a temporary loss of hearing, vision, and smell. Subject then attempted to apprehend the humanoid but stumbled and fell onto a cold, rocky surface unconnected to the facility floor felt seconds before. Subject spent remaining ten days of shift alternating between pacing, sleeping, crying, and consuming rations, and despite a lack of auditory or visual input, reports "hearing from [his] hands" an avian entity having slowly and constantly approached from the distance, before landing on his head, sighing, and continuing in the opposite direction.

  • Retrieved Items: One woolen robe, determined by testing to be nonflammable and self-cleaning. When left unobserved after testing, was replaced with or transmuted to 5 ml of Ovis aries semen and a large black feather of indeterminate genetic makeup.

Requests: Emergency meeting with provided therapist. Granted.

C4R-DB0-4RD

Retrieval: Uneventful

Description: Subject appeared in a series of tunnels that were filled with murines, ophidians, and arachnids covered in cardboard Items (in the form of boxes and tubes). After 10 minutes, several humanoids covered in cardboard, around the ages of 6-12 appeared, repeatedly saying “I don’t want to play anymore.”, “I’m the Tunnel Monster.”, “Help me.”, and other similar phrases. Subject manifested back to the site as the creatures started climbing on top of him.

After subject described the appearance of these “monsters”, they were noted to closely resemble SCP-3663. After Site-54 was contacted, Director ██████ of the site claimed SCP-3663 was still in their tunnels. After this encounter, it is believed that there are more instances of SCP-3663 that have yet to be contained.

  • Retrieved Item(s): A murine covered in cardboard items.

Request(s): A pet cage for the recovered murine. - Granted.

TNT-LUS-IC9

Retrieval: Uneventful

Description: Subject shifted while sleeping but quickly awoke due to its new extremely warm environment, estimated to be somewhere from 40-45ºC. The location was within a subterranean tunnel and very moist, with a soft black mold covering most of the rocky surfaces. After roughly 50 meters of travel through the tunnel and making a sharp right turn, the subject entered a large hemispherical cavern with a lake of roughly 200 meters diameter containing an olive tree stretching upwards an unknown distance into a dark crevice, as well as an emaciated unmoving humanoid perfectly resembling SCP-3048 in its center. At this point, the subject noticed all water native to TNT-LUS-IC9 became a highly durable ice when exposed to his natural body heat and failed to melt when removed. Further long-range inspection also revealed the humanoid to be frozen in place up to its waist roughly 3 meters from the tree's lowest branches.

After fifteen minutes, the humanoid awoke and noticed the subject, beginning to loudly vocalize in an unknown Italian dialect and gesture at the tree and the water. Subject considered a rescue attempt but feared becoming similarly trapped in the lake and reentered the tunnel, traveling along it for roughly 300 meters before again finding himself at the same cavern. Here, the humanoid was observed attempting to smash the ice with its own skull for several seconds before recognizing the subject and hurriedly pointing at the tree. Shortly afterwards, a cervine entity at least 4 meters in height descended from the tree's hidden upper branches and urinated on the humanoid's head before retreating once more.

Subject spent the remaining 8 hours of the shift consuming rations, pacing, and sleeping on the edges of the cavern and ignoring the now-screaming humanoid.

  • Retrieved Items: Samples of previously noted black mold. Tests proved close genetic relation to Aspergillus wentii. ~200 ml of anomalous water. Chemical analysis showed no difference from standard water, although crosstests with similar anomalies suggest [REDACTED].

Requests: Reading material with which to more easily pass time. Granted.

CPR-VAN-098

Retrieval: Subject appeared three miles off site and had stayed in a local gym until containment operatives arrived.

Description: Subject materialized roughly four feet above the ground and fell into muddled ground, spraining its ankle. It claimed to have been at the bottom of a massive crater. After a couple hours the subject managed to crawl its way out of the crater to discover that it was in a world where time seemed to have stopped. It saw people and animals frozen in place. It saw birds frozen mid-flight in the sky and the sun remained at the same point in the sky during its four day stay in the reality. It found a working smart phone and found that the date was frozen at 02/07/2034. Subject explored the local town until it found building 100 meters tall with a V logo and the word “Vanguard” in big green letters above the entrance. Inside it found many individuals whose identities matched that of several Foundation staff.

Requests: None

UE6-111-4A7

Retrieval: Via tracking device. Subject was found attempting to return to the site, but with some difficulty. This was intially belived to stem from inebriation, but upon interviewing the subject was determined to instead be due to vection2 caused by extended exposure to a non-stationary environment.

Description: Subject arrived in a populated area experiencing what it perceived as "at least" a magnitude 7 earthquake. Despite this, subject noted a distinct lack of infrastructure damage. Local inhabitants expressed confusion upon subject's attempts to question them about the unusual amount of tectonic activity. After 30 minutes, subject was approached by law enforcement and detained under suspicion of public intoxication due to its inability to stand or walk normally.

At the police station, subject learned that the current level of tectonic activity was considered normal in this universe. Almost all architecture was designed to incorporate a complex series of gyroscopes and gimbals that offset the constant motion it was subjected to.

Subject was released after passing a breathalyzer test. Unable to contact a local Foundation equivalent and lacking sufficient funds for better accommodations, it eventually settled in a homeless encampment located in the city's central park, where it adjusted to the constant motion over several days.

On day 47 of its shift, subject was awoken in the middle of the night. Although at first unable to identify what had awakened it besides a feeling of dizziness and nausea, subject quickly discovered that the shaking it had become accustomed to had entirely ceased. It was then further roused by the sound of screaming, sirens, and distant rumbling crashes and explosions.

Upon exiting its tent, subject discovered that the area had been impacted by a "magnitude 0.00003 earthstill" which had leveled much of the city. With no counterbalancing tectonic activity, the massive gimbals integral to the city had ripped themselves from their foundations and destroyed the buildings they supported, crushing or trapping thousands of civilians under the rubble.

Subject spent the remaining nine days as part of a volunteer disaster response effort attempting to extricate survivors from the ruins.

Requests: None.

WR3-4GD-4H4

Retrieval: Uneventful.

Description: Subject arrived in a dimension with a reversed day and night cycle, and found it difficult to adapt for the first two days.

No further unusual traits were noted until the subject came across a small village, which was populated entirely by what appeared to be human children. Children ranged from around three years old to roughly ten years old, and appeared to be in a constant state of panic. Children would attempt to avoid the subject, and would shriek in fear if they were looked at.

Subject eventually made its way to the center of the village, where it found an empty playground, with a merry-go-round in the center. Upon moving closer to the merry-go-round, a child wearing a black hooded sweater appeared, and began to watch the subject. Subject moved closer to the child, at which point the child began to back away, still staring at the subject through the eyeholes of its hood.

Subject followed the child around the village, and eventually caught up to it at the edge of the village. Child was standing in front of a dark doorway, with no apparent door handle. Child then backed through the door, and the door closed behind it.

Subject attempted to press its ear to the door, but found that it was too cold to touch.

Requests: None.

S7V-OQ2-B7O

Retrieval: Via tracking device. Subject was found at the bottom of a large canyon in a state of severe malnutrition and dehydration.

Description: Subject arrived in a dimension where it observed its own body with no apparent changes. Subject did not find any unusual changes until after it had eaten its first meal, which it reported as "tasteless and bland."

Subject also reported a severe increase in hunger after eating, such that it could eat multiple meals without any apparent change in hunger. This hunger increased exponentially over the course of a week. Subject refused to eat or drink the last two days before it shifted back.

Requests: A full-course meal. Granted after the subject had recovered from its malnutrition.

M3R-RYX-MA5

Retrieval: Uneventful.

Description: Subject arrived in a populated area in the Midwestern United States where Christmas decorations were put up on houses and buildings despite the date being in early September. Upon further investigation, the subject learned that most widely celebrated religious winter holidays were celebrated throughout the entire year in this reality. Throughout the duration of its stay, the subject observed mostly Christmas festivities and celebrations, likely due to the religious demographics of its location. Subject noted that this change had minimal impact on everyday life for most, but it did have some cultural impacts such as all music being holiday themed (most popular songs were Christmas oriented) and people using holiday-skewed variations of common phrases such as "we'll wrap that gift when we get to it" and "you can give a reindeer a red nose, but you can't make it glow".

Starting in the month of December, subject noted that people were preparing for "the winter holidays" by taking down and ceasing all holiday-oriented decorations and festivities. Subject noted that during this time, radios stopped playing holiday-oriented music and instead played music similar to what would normally be heard on the radio in baseline reality, which most people seemed to have a strong distaste of.

Approximately 3 months into its stay, the subject noticed that it was being followed by two men. Subject claims that one looked similar to Agent ██████, a plainclothes agent who had previously helped retrieve the subject during the events of entry 000-000-000. After being followed for 10 minutes, a red and green van with the markings "Snow Cookies Presents" pulled up next to the subject. Subject shifted after multiple armored men with weapons stepped out of the van and approached it.

Requests: For all winter holiday-oriented decorations set up around the facility to be taken down, as the subject shifted back on December ██. Denied.

RQ4-067-C5L

Retrieval: Subject and visiting Sr. Researcher A. Yik from Site-48 were found in Site-19 hallway, in good physical condition.

Description: Shift occurred as the subject was mid-fall after slipping on residue from SCP-███ while roaming near its containment cell; S.R. Yik, who was still unaware of the finer points of local protocol such as prohibition of physical contact after two weeks since previous shift, reached out to catch subject and was subsequently taken as well. The duo appeared in underground ruins of indeterminate cultural origin. After explanation of situation and consequences of a similar previous incident (see Addendum 507-00 of primary file), S.R. Yik made sure to keep a physical grasp of subject at all times from then on, even as they proceeded to begin taking detailed notes and recorded observations of the physical state, inscriptions, layout, and local artifacts. Valuable observations were collected, including potential implied context behind [REDACTED], as the duo continued in such activity over the next 13 hours, until the return shift back occurred to the express relief of the subject and contrasting disappointment of S.R. Yik.

Requests:

  • Mobile gaming device for any future long stretches of inactivity - Denied; potential issues due to unnecessary electronic devices in unpredictable environments deemed unwarranted.
  • Box of Lego bricks - Denied; too bulky considering range of other approved items.
  • Rubik's Cube - Approved (Keychain-sized miniature version).

M1M-3W0-RLD

Retrieval: Subject manifested inside the first floor Site-19 women's bathroom, startling Guest Researcher K, who subsequently struck the subject unconscious, believing the subject to be a peeping tom.

Description: Subject manifested in an alley, and quickly discovered nearly all color was replaced with shades of white, black, or grey. In addition, the subject found sound could only be produced by speaking, and striking objects, snapping fingers, and other such activities made no noise. The subject exited the alley and found a city street filled with people, all dressed as mimes, communicating in an unknown form of Sign Language. Some individuals manifesting anomalous properties by appearing to pedal a bike or drive a car, and gliding at a high speed down the middle of the street.

The subject attempted to ask passersby where it was, but all individuals suddenly clamped their hands over their ears and winced at the noise, with individuals appearing to ride bikes or drive cars suddenly falling to the ground, some being severely injured by their inertia, but did not cry out. After the cringing subsided, the subject found all individuals staring at it in varying degrees of horror. Subject was shortly after handcuffed and apprehended by several headphone-wearing individuals, duct tape placed across its mouth, and taken to the third floor of a nearby building.

One individual attempted to communicate in sign language with the subject, but eventually gave up and forcibly showed the subject a handwritten note detailing that the subject was "an Aberrant Being capable of generating sounds in excess of a full decibel" and a specialist team from the Aberrancy Security Vault would thus "soon be here to take [it] to a facility suited to house [it] for the foreseeable future." Subject spent the next hour attempting to learn sign language from scratch, following the individual's movements, but returned to this dimension right as several other headphone-wearing individuals appeared to take it to what it assumed was an alternate version of an SCP Facility.

Requests Sign language lessons. Granted.

K11-NFD-040

Retrieval: Subject displayed relatively diminished communication skills and vocabulary. Retrieval was otherwise uneventful.

Description: Subject arrived in a location which it described as "somewhere in Africa". Analysis of the recovered video footage revealed that the location in question closely resembled a replica of our universe's city of Kampala with the primary exception being that the city's entire landscape was covered in wild plant life native to Central Africa, which is typical for cities which has been abandoned by the human populace for significant lengths of time. The subject soon discovered the city to be inhabited by an unusually dense population of great and lesser apes (including chimpanzees, bonobos, gorillas, orangutans and gibbons). The inhabitants of the city displayed familiarity with guerilla warfare and close-quarters combat tactics, far greater than what is considered normal for non-anomalous non-human apes. A battalion consisting mainly of chimpanzees equipped with guns of various makes and types, bulletproof vests, army attire, and forest camouflage ambushed and restrained the subject; and began preparing to ceremonially execute it. However, the battalion themselves were ambushed by an enemy battalion consisting of humans. The video footage was lost at this point.

The subject recalls just barely avoiding dying on the battlefied during the ensuing conflict. The subject was taken as a prisoner of war by the apes and forcefully brought to a concentration camp, stripped of its belongings and incarcerated in a cage, placed in an area containing many other detainees and mercilessly beaten upon attempting to communicate with one of its captors. Through watching news material viewed by its captors, subject managed to learn that the universe it shifted to was a world dominated by sapient non-human apes as the superior species. Humans were also present in this reality, although they lacked sapience unlike their close relatives the apes. Subject also learned that the Earth's counterpart of universe K11-NFD-040 was experiencing a violent SK-Class Dominance Shift Scenario perpetrated by the human populace which had achieved a higher level of intellect through unknown means, named 'the Great Human Revolution' or 'the Great Human-Ape War' by the inhabitants of K11-NFD-040. By the time of the subject's arrival, the human-ape conflict had consumed well over 45% of Central Africa, and many important African cities such as Kampala, Mbuji-Mayi and Bangui had fallen under human administration.

Subject was soon noted for its unusually developed motor abilities, which were considered extraordinarily advanced for a human. Subject's ape captors reacted with shock after discovering that the subject is sapient. The subject was successfully taught the language of the inhabitants of the universe which faintly resembled a mix of Swahili and Dutch. Subject was offered to serve the ape armed forces in the ongoing war with humans, but was teleported back to our universe before it had a chance to deny the offer. Subject insists that if it actually had a chance to respond, it would turn the offer down as it finds its body to be grossly out of shape for armed conflict.

Requests:

  • Grammar lessons. Granted.
  • Psychiatric treatment for subject's PTSD. Denied, the subject was not diagnosed with PTSD despite the traumatic nature of the experience.

D0-N07-3N73R

Retrieval: Uneventful.

Description: Subject found itself in a reality where the landscape appeared barren, littered with remnants of advanced machinery and structures stretching across the horizon. Tall, multiarmed robots patrolled the area with precision, emitting low mechanical hums as they surveyed the surroundings. The subject cautiously maneuvered through the desolate landscape, utilizing cover to evade detection by the robot patrols. Subject took refuge behind what appeared to be a dormant manufacturing facility, where it discovered other humans hiding.
The subject followed them into their hideout and gathered information about the situation.

The Earth of dimension D0-N07-3N73R had been colonized by an advanced extraterrestrial species known as the Xyloths. Humanity, deemed inferior and subjugated by the Xyloths, exists as a subservient race, subjected to harsh conditions and strict governance under the Xylothian regime. The Xyloths, possessing superior technology and intellect, established a totalitarian regime. Human society was divided into labor camps and controlled settlements.

Xylothian technology dominates the planet. Massive structures of unknown materials loom over landscapes, serving as administrative centers and living quarters for the Xyloths. Advanced surveillance systems monitor every human movement. The human population lives in fear and oppression, stripped of basic rights and individual freedoms. Propaganda reinforces the belief in Xylothian superiority while suppressing any form of human resistance or rebellion. Human language and culture are systematically eroded, replaced by Xylothian directives and ideologies. Interaction between Xyloths and humans is minimal and strictly hierarchical.

Humans are treated as disposable entities, subject to labor exploitation and harsh disciplinary measures. Any attempt at resistance is met with swift and severe punishment, often resulting in public executions or cruel experimentation. Despite the overwhelming control imposed by the Xyloths, small underground resistance groups persist, clandestinely organizing and planning acts of defiance. However, these movements face constant surveillance and infiltration by Xylothian informants, leading to frequent dismantling of their operations.

Requests: None.

1N-F1N173-1K34

Retrieval: Via tracking device.

Description: Subject found itself within what it described as an "infinite furniture store", a space whose dimensions defied conventional measurement. The vast expanse of the store extended endlessly, comprising shelves, alcoves, and corridors that seemed to stretch into infinity. Each aisle showcased a myriad of furniture pieces, ranging from antique chairs to modern couches, arranged in repetitive yet seemingly boundless patterns.

Upon further exploration, the subject discovered a cafeteria within the labyrinthine store that exclusively served freshly made meatballs, emitting a tantalizing aroma. However, the lack of any identifiable source for the meatballs raised a disconcerting uncertainty. Despite this, the individual consumed them as its sole sustenance throughout its shift.

Midway through its shift, the subject encountered a humanoid figure devoid of any discernible facial features, its form distorted and disfigured. The faceless entity, assumed to be wearing a staff uniform, moved silently, gliding through the aisles, arranging and repositioning furniture. Despite the absence of a visible countenance, the entity appeared to be aware of the subject's presence, occasionally turning its featureless head in the subject's direction.

After an elapsed period of approximately six hours, a sudden blackout engulfed the store, numerous staff members, each lacking discernible facial features, commenced a rapid sprint towards the subject. These faceless figures emitted an unsettling, incomprehensible sound from their featureless heads. The subject, unable to comprehend or recall the nature of these utterances, described it as an unknown language. Filled with panic, subject fled the scene in an urgent attempt to ensure its safety before shifting back.

Requests:

  • Amnestic treatment. Denied.
  • Meatballs. Granted.

K21-N07-F21

Retrieval: Subject manifested inside the first floor Site-19 women's bathroom, mid-swing, and subsequently struck Guest Researcher K unconscious.

Description: Subject appeared in a wooden complex with a Chinese aesthetic, with dozens of small rooms for various purposes, such as sleeping and cooking. As the subject moved through the complex, it found a courtyard where several humans were training by repeating anomalous feats of strength, endurance, and speed at the direction of a humanoid composed of liquid metal with a droplet-shaped head, referred to by the subject as [sic] "Master Gooru … with two o's …".

The humanoid was alarmed at subject's presence and threatened subject, assuming it to be an intruder, but accepted subject's explanation of its anomalous properties, citing this universe's equivalent of the subject being its pupil, though currently in the middle of its own shift. To stay in the complex, the subject was tasked with chores by the metallic humanoid, though a majority of the other individuals in the complex took offense to subject's "easy entrance" to the complex, which was supposedly high in the mountains.

After a week, subject asked to join in training to alleviate its boredom, and was permitted to begin by the metallic humanoid, though physiological differences between humans from this universe and the baseline universe forced subject to remain at early stages of training throughout its stay. After another two or three days, subject demonstrated elevated levels of stamina and strength akin to a high-tier athlete from the baseline universe, cited by the metallic humanoid as due to a higher density of nutrients in this universe's food.

In the final day of its shift, subject mentioned that a fox-like humanoid with several tails entered the complex along with several other humans, having come from a rival complex across the mountain to challenge the metallic humanoid's. Each of the rival group's humans was paired with one from the metallic humanoid's to perform a non-lethal duel, with the victorious complex being the one who won at least 7 of 13 duels, with subject being pitted against the smallest and youngest " … but fiercest … " member of the rival group in the absence of its counterpart.

Though several humans in the metallic humanoid's group lost, subject won its duel and barely eked out the seventh victory for the metallic humanoid's complex. As a reward for its victory, a party was held by the metallic humanoid and its human pupils, who now respected subject. At the end of the party, subject noticed its counterpart had shifted back to this universe and proposed a duel, but to its distress, shifted back to baseline universe in the middle of its first punch.

Requests

  • Clothing worn during shift back. Denied, articles sent for testing.
  • Training dummy or sandbag for its room. Denied.
  • Martial arts lessons. Granted.
  • More exercise in its routine. Granted.

G01-M09-N07

Retrieval: Uneventful.

Description: Subject manifested on a large green plain, where everything including the subject appeared to be a cel-shaded form, and subject noted its proportions were significantly altered to be stocky and short, with large eyes and a round nose.

When the subject attempted to jump over a nearby ledge, it did so at three times its own height, and landed safely, to its surprise. After an hour of crossing the plains and evading being detected by several nonhumanoid entities, it came to an area where cubes composed of bricks were suspended in the air, and a humanoid in [REDACTED], presumably native to the environment, was breaking the cubes by jumping up and punching them from below.

Subject followed the individual for a short time, intending to ask where it was, before everything, including the subject and the humanoid, became frozen for several minutes. Subject shifted back before anything else could occur.

Addendum: During subject's shift, Agent A████, who was playing ███ █████ █████
████. ███ in the Site-19 break room, discovered an anomalous glitch in the game where an entity, similar in description to the subject's description of itself during its shift, appeared in the middle of a level and followed the player character, █████. Agent A, unsure of what to do, paused the game and, at the direction of Guest Researcher K several minutes later, shut the system off.

Analysis of the moment in which Agent A████ shut off the game revealed the entity resembling subject to disappear 0.73 seconds before the screen turned black and 0.0001 seconds before subject shifted back to baseline reality.

Requests: None.

V15-I03-E19

Retrieval: Subject shifted back with nearly-fatal lacerations around the neck, resembling tooth marks from a large, predatory animal.

Description: Subject manifested in a dark cave and heard dripping water nearby. When subject turned on its flashlight, it found the cave walls were made of flesh, and drops of a reddish fluid that smelled like blood fell from white, fang-like stalactites overhead. Unnerved, subject proceeded in the direction that seemed to lead up to the surface.

As it did so, subject heard a human voice from deeper in the cave behind itself, which asked various questions of odd natures, but did not appear to understand or respond to subject's own. Subject continued to ascend, increasing in pace as the voice got closer and other voices began to join in asking.

Subject threateningly fired off a warning shot into the cavern below, which caused the voices to stop, but as subject turned to continue upwards, it came face to face with an eyeless, red-skinned creature with elongated jaws which spoke in subject's voice to ask "What makes you think you can get out this way?"

Subject shifted back as the creature lunged to bite at subject's throat.

Requests: None.

C15-L15-N25

Retrieval: Subject returned covered in miniscule buildings and anomalously small humanoids, proportionally one two-hundredth the size of baseline reality humans. Buildings and humanoids collected and relocated to Site-███ and classified as SCP-████. Escaped instances of SCP-████-1 assumed dead due to Site-19 decontamination protocols.

Description: Subject manifested in a large ditch, and noted the sky seemed to flicker between bright and dark about once per second. On closer inspection of the ground, what was thought to be grass was instead miniscule trees, the tallest of which being only five inches or so tall. When the subject stood up, it noted its head felt cool, and the edges of the ditch were bare stone with snowy caps, resembling mountain ranges.

Subject sat and planned for roughly one and a half minutes before it felt an itch on its leg, noting the sensation was caused by a group of miniscule humanoids less than a quarter of a centimeter tall each, moving " … like they were on super fast forward … " and erecting simple wooden houses. Subject observed the humanoids and noted their rapid improvement of the structures using materials from the ground around subject's legs, developing multi-story buildings after only thirty seconds.

After a minute, subject attempted to relocate the humanoids to the ground by delicately placing their buildings on the ground, but this seemed to push the humanoids to settle on subject's shoulders and head instead. Subject, as a last resort to drive the humanoids to go elsewhere, stood up to put its head and shoulders in the cool area, but the humanoids developed more well-insulated houses and harnessed fire. Subject traveled through the ditch to a more open area, hoping to find a more suitable place than its own body for the humanoids to inhabit, but the humanoids did not leave.

Roughly ten minutes later, subject had walked a great distance singing to itself to stave off boredom, and its chest and back were both covered in hanging wooden houses while castle-like stone buildings covered its head and shoulders. At this time, subject felt a sharp pang on its wrist and lifted it, noting the humanoids had camped there in the time it had taken to raise its hand. The humanoids then produced words in English, stating they had spent two years translating subject's language, and asked it to share its wisdom for them.

Subject stated it had been looking for a place to leave the humanoids, but the humanoids refused to leave, describing subject's body as a holy land. Intrigued, subject decided to ask about the humanoids' history and beliefs.

[History and Religion details in SCP-████ file]

Afterwards, subject gave in and told the humanoids its name was Grabnok the Destroyer, prompting the humanoids to rename their colony to Grabnok Colony. Several minutes later, after crossing a small plain and a waist-deep saltwater lake, described by the humanoids as a large sea, subject shifted back to baseline reality.

Requests

  • Occasional visits to the people of Grabnok Colony (SCP-████). Pending approval.

H05-A22-E14

Retrieval: Uneventful.

Description: Subject manifested in a breathable, zero-g environment containing wisps of golden mist and brightly illuminated from an unknown light source. Subject found it could move through the environment by "swimming" and did so for several minutes, looking for any solid object that might be used as a landmark.

Subject noted a feeling of being watched at some point, and turned to see two small white lifeforms, resembling winged "keyhole shapes" with only two small black dots for eyes and a small mouth, observing it from behind a bank of the mists. Subject attempted to communicate with them, but the lifeforms did not recognize subject's verbal or sign languages, responding with high pitched, musical sounding vocalizations. Several other similar lifeforms appeared, and one, capable of speaking English, asked the subject what it was doing here.

Subject explained its anomalous properties, but the lifeforms only seemed to become more uneasy. The lifeform that had asked earlier explained that other universes' instances of the subject had arrived in this universe before, and each time the universal force that punched them through into this one would allow a part of "the ancestral enemy" in.

Almost immediately, subject and the lifeforms noticed a black mass similar to a fracture in the golden mists appearing in the distance. Estimations from the subject's description put the size of the mass as about one kilometer in width and three kilometers from subject's location upon first sighting it, though it seemed to grow larger over the course of a minute.

The lifeforms around the subject immediately bowed their heads and began chanting, and subject looked up to see motes of light floating from the lifeforms to a particularly dense mass of golden mist above them, where the unknown light source seemed to originate. The light source suddenly brightened and subject looked away towards the growing black mass, before a stream of golden energy lanced out from the unknown light source into the black mass.

The illumination provided by the golden stream revealed the mass to act like a hole, through which several entities around an immense, red-skinned humanoid with large horns could be seen. Viewing the central humanoid induced a cognitohazardous effect in the subject, causing it a severe headache and a sudden surge in sadistic impulses.

Before subject could act on these impulses, the golden stream was joined by several others, blocking subject's view of the humanoid, before a single far thicker stream struck the black mass's center and destroyed it, leaving only golden mists behind. Subject only remembered turning to look at the light source, now unobscured by mists, one more time before shifting back.

Subject appeared to be dazed for several seconds upon shifting back, but became lucid with minimal interaction. Subject could only describe the light source as "…[it thinks it] saw God…"

Requests

  • To ask SCP-343 if what subject saw was SCP-343 or not. Denied.

B18-O11-E14

Retrieval: Via tracking device. Subject was found 2000 miles east of Site-19 on a deserted island in the ██████ Ocean.

Description: Subject manifested in an abandoned, dimly-lit city, noting lighting conditions as similar to dusk, though the sky was light purple and lacked stars or other defined celestial bodies. Subject also noted that nearly all buildings were missing large portions, many of which included vital structural elements, yet did not collapse. Subject began to search for intelligent lifeforms, crossing several cracks in the ground that " … had no bottom, they just opened into the sky underground … ".

After two or three hours, subject sat down to eat when a second instance of the subject, notably taller and with heterochromatic eyes, manifested within 50 meters of subject. The second subject demonstrated familiarity with the universe's terrain, but had no recollection of the immediate area. The second subject informed subject that there were intelligent lifeforms native to the universe, multicolored humanoids with odd proportions, and that they were supposedly responsible for "breaking" their universe by attempting to replicate the properties of their own universe's version of the subject in others.

Subject and second subject moved through the space for several hours, conversing on differences between their universes, before a (previously-assumed decorative) anklet on second subject started beeping. Second subject quickly explained the band was developed as a thirty-second warning for when it was about to shift. Subject attempted to ask how it worked, but second subject only explained it required [REDACTED] to function before returning to its own reality.

Subject remained for two more hours and noted spotting one of the universe's natives on a rooftop, but returned to baseline reality before subject could ascend the building's stairs and attempt to interact with the humanoid. Humanoid was noted as being pink with numerous cartoon heart-shaped growths on its head instead of hair.

Requests:

  • A replica of Second Subject's anklet or close approximation. Pending. Research into use of [REDACTED] on hold due to the volatile anomalous nature of the substance.

XJ9-V22-P74

Retrieval: Subject appeared in Basement Storage Room 4 sitting on a crate. Subject was covered in sweat and breathing heavily with signs of exhaustion.

Description: Subject found itself in an area similar to the Foundation cafeteria but filled with SCP Corporation brand vending machines and dispensaries. Subject quickly realized this dimension’s SCP Foundation was instead a for profit corporation (SCP-1437-2). Corporate employees in the cafeteria were surprised at the subject's shift and immediately contacted security. Subject was told to freeze at gunpoint. Destination dimension did not have (or did not know of) an analogue of the subject and suspected it of utilizing an unknown thaumaturgy to shift, which they assumed was teleporting within the same universe. When subject attempted to comply while explaining itself, one security guard used a ranged taser while the other held up a high beam strobe light and sounded a continuous airhorn. Presumably this was to prevent subject from casting thaumaturgies. Subject was gagged and its limbs were clamped to a metal chair bolted to the floor of the interrogation room it was detained in.

Subject was surrounded by six security guards, four with pistols pointed at him, one with a taser pointed at him, and one with the strobe light and airhorn. When he attempted to speak the airhorn and strobe light were used followed by the guard commanding him not to speak unless spoken to. After waiting for a while in silence, a woman spoke through the speaker above the two-way mirror. She introduced herself as "Sarah Syler, Director of Thaumaturgic Operations" and ordered security to stand down but remain at the ready. She removed the gag stating “It’s likely not a parleglyph.” and interrogated the subject who was finally allowed to explain himself. The director then entered the interrogation room. She was professionally dressed and wore a security badge with the SCP Corporation symbol as well as a pentacle with a horizontal eye placed within the central pentagon. She looked at him closely and asked him if he was a reality bender. Subject replied “No, I don’t think so. I just shift into other dimensions. I can’t control it either.”

The director then performed what was likely a kinetoglyph which was obscured by strobe light directed at the subject. Director then grabbed subject’s head with both hands and stared into his eyes. Subject reports the feeling that she was “staring into my soul”. She then accused the subject of lying stating that although he was not a reality bender he had clear signs of “weaving behind the eyes”. She also noted that the subject had teleported directly into a site meant specifically for thaumaturgic study, and that this could not have been an accident as the subject had claimed. She then claimed the subject would be charged with industrial and corporate espionage unless the subject performed the kinetoglyph that allows it to teleport. She stated that the subject must do this in clear view of the camera which she pointed out.

Subject was released from the chair and the director and guards stood back, but still guarded the door. Subject pleaded with the director, repeatedly insisting it had no control over its ability and that it was anomalous, not thaumaturgic. Director threatened the subject and ordered the guards to draw their weapons. Subject then lied pretending to reveal the truth that it simply had not mastered its kinetoglyph and was afraid it would transport it to a hazardous area. The director seemed pleased but continued to insist the subject perform the kinetoglyph under threat of violence.

Subject recalls the next statement the director made, as it was intriguing. “This is going to be a huge unlock for the entire corporation if we just align it to our clients. Just imagine the revenue of instantly, and I mean instantly transporting goods. Size and weight might not even be a factor with this thaumaturgy. We would become the most utilized corporation in all of history, overnight. Of course, let’s not boil the ocean here. We wouldn’t want to show our whole hand all at once. Let’s circle back. You. Perform the kinetoglyph.” Subject then claimed it was a very long kinetoglyph that could take a very long time to perform. The director still insisted while continuing to “go on and on with a lot of corporate jargon I couldn't understand”.

Subject eventually proceeded to improvise gestures incorporating sign language, which none of them seemed to correctly recognize. Subject went through the entire alphabet of signs and every single signed phrase it could think of, many of which were gibberish. Once the subject ran out of those, it switched to dance-like movements and pantomiming. The entire process took at least three hours before the subject finally shifted back.

Requests:

  • Knowledge on thaumaturgy. Denied due to potential dangers. However, the subject was informed that the Foundation has no available information on “weaving behind the eyes” or “parleglyphs”, nor does this event arouse suspicion among research staff that the subject is capable of any thaumaturgy.
  • Tests on if the subject’s shifts have a limit to size and weight of objects shifted with it. Pending. Likely unnecessary.

P21-N03-H04

Retrieval: Subject returned one second after shifting, flying backwards and falling prone with a severe concussion.

Description: Subject manifested in a boxing ring with painfully bright spotlights on it. Within half a second of manifestation, subject saw a red boxing glove and fell unconscious.

Requests: None legible.

NAT-07-P7R

Retrieval: Returned 50 meters outside Site-19, suffering from severe burns.

Description: The subject manifested in an abandoned version of Site-19. The subject noted several corpses belonging to Foundation staff, many of which had been charred. Upon exiting the facility, the subject encountered a group of short avian entities wielding flamethrowers and wearing what appeared to the subject to be flame-retardant environmental suits. Upon spotting the subject, the entities attacked it with their flamethrowers. Subject demanifested after 5 seconds of exposure to the flames. Upon recovery, subject noted that the nearby city of [REDACTED] appeared to have been demolished by a nuclear weapon.

Requests: Heat resistant clothing. Granted.

S16-H09-N24

Retrieval: Returned three hours prior to its shift in [DATA EXPUNGED]. Subject was immediately evacuated and restricted to a secure location until its past self shifted.

Description: Subject manifested several meters above the ground and sprained its ankle in the resulting fall. Subject manifested in a plaza at night, containing numerous entities resembling winged lions with humanoid faces and chests. Subject noted the entities appeared to be partaking in various forms of playing, dancing, eating, and [DATA EXPUNGED], but did not move even when prodded as though frozen. The edges of the plaza were ringed with housing made to accommodate creatures of the entities' size.

Subject searched the plaza and found a small entity, unfrozen, resembling a silvery winged reptile, which hid from subject but was coaxed out by the offer of subject's rations. Entity spoke in a childish voice at first, asking how Subject arrived and later revealed to be fearing an invasion of sorts by humans. Other attributes of this reality included the following:

  • The city Subject appeared in was the sole territory of a race of the winged leonine entities, referred to as Sphinxes.
  • The city allied with an expansionist empire due to the Sphinxes' ability to predict various futures predicting the highest chance of survival being with the empire.
  • The empire fell despite this, and to defend themselves from persecution by the enemies of the empire, the Sphinxes used a thaumaturgical process to divorce their city from time itself, creating a new reality that the Subject manifested in.
  • The process used to divorce the city required the imbuing of a "dragon's egg" with Sphinx blood, creating the silvery entity.
  • A side effect of the process caused the Sphinxes to slowly freeze in time, leading to the remainder to partake in mass hedonism and freeze in eternal moments of bliss.

Subject noted that at various points in the conversation, the entity would rapidly grow in size to about twenty meters in length or rapidly shrink to its standard one meter again, particularly when it seemed to feel anger or sadness respectively. The entity described this as being capable of controlling its apparent age, but not being proficient as its true age was ██ months.

Entity briefly attempted to try changing the age of subject to test if it could before subject told it not to. Subject then noticed its ankle was healed as Entity stated subject was now three hours younger and the time in which it was injured no longer existed. Subject shifted back to baseline reality shortly afterward, but found it had arrived three hours before it had shifted.

Requests: None.

N15-A18-M19

Retrieval: Via tracker. Subject manifested with an anomalous prosthetic arm gripping its own. Subject sustained major bruising and a broken humerus from the immense grip force endured. Medical attention applied afterwards.

Description: Subject manifested in an alleyway at night, and camped out until morning. Upon awakening, subject found a child prodding at subject with a stick. Gently pushing the stick away, subject apparently scared the child, causing them to run away.

Subject exited the alleyway to see small groups of humans about, and subsequently subject noticed all humans possessed multiple prosthetic arms, most with only two, but several with three or more. Subject covered its arms in a heavy cloak taken from the alley trash to fit in, and left for a public space.

Subject sat with an elderly individual to ask questions. Subject found that all humans in this reality were born without arms since an unknown event at least 100 years prior (the individual noted their grandparents were the last in their family to have natural arms). Subject then left to find accommodations, but was tailed and detained by a six-armed police officer for "disturbing the peace", subject complied with authorities until they removed its cloak as part of a routine search, exposing subject's arms.

Subject was kept in the local jail for two days afterwards, trying but failing to explain its circumstances to others. Eventually, a man presumed to be a foundation-equivalent agent of this reality visited. Subject went to go with the agent, but shifted back while the agent was grabbing subject's arm, taking the agent's prosthetic with it. Separated from agent's nervous signals, the prosthetic arm's grip repeatedly tightened until subject's arm broke.

Requests:
*Medical attention (received, see Doctor's Log:507-#116 for information on anomalous parasite extracted)

*Prosthetic arm (sent for study)

B7B-2NH-1A3

Retrieval: Uneventful

Description: Subject arrived in a forest where a group of students were fighting a group of [sic] "… weirdos …" dressed in strange cosplay. After explaining subject's properties, the students let Subject stay in their school for the time being, allowing subject to learn about the world's population of "Superheroes", their society, and the requirements of being a hero.

Subject describes the world as an Ideal Superhero world for true Superhero fans, with anomalously empowered humans becoming ordinary in all aspects of society, both moral and amoral. Subject also described an incident in which it defended a young child from an anomalous individual threatening her.

Requests: A collection of Golden age comic books to read. Approved.

N15-E25-E19

Retrieval: Subject manifested blindly sprinting headfirst, colliding with Guest Researcher K at high speeds and inducing a concussion in both individuals.

Description: Subject manifested in a dark, maze-like area composed of massive stone bricks about three feet each in height and seven feet in length, with patches of soundproofing material covering most surfaces. Using its flashlight, subject explored for several minutes before encountering a humanoid with smooth skin covering where its eyes should be. Humanoid was friendly and spoke in a barely comprehensible accent, making communication somewhat slow.

Apparently sensing subject via echolocation and expressing pity at subject for apparently having lost the ability to echolocate as well, the humanoid guided subject to an area of barren walls, then to a small house made from mismatched wooden planks and blankets in a dead-end of the maze. Humanoid revealed the maze as a former prison, and that it is impossible to navigate the "muffled" areas because they mess with echolocation, though it mentioned subject was already used to living like that.

Subject accepted a small meal and offered assistance in any way, which the humanoid used to have subject help it go to a nearby medical clinic where subject could have its echolocation glands surgically corrected. After asking where those were, Humanoid tapped the smooth parts where its eyes should be. Subject spent the rest of the shift running from the humanoid, which was insistent on subject receiving treatment.

Requests: None.

M4E-23R-1RI

Retrieval: Subject manifested in Dr. Clef's office. Dr. Clef (who had been taken with the subject during this shift) exited the office and remained silent for the remainder of the day.

Description: Dr. Clef intentionally disobeyed protocols concerning subject for unknown reasons, securely gripping subject for several seconds until a shift occurred. Subject refused to report on this shift's reality, citing a respect for Dr. Clef's privacy. Subject only stated [sic] "It was like witnessing the life that he wished he had". Subject offered no other explanation.

Requests: To see Dr. Clef more often. Approved.

N15-S15-U12

Retrieval: Uneventful. Subject returned coated in non-anomalous dust.

Description: Subject manifested in a foggy, monochrome city, the weather noted as being overcast the entire shift. Subject encountered humans in the streets, but all were identical. Thin, hairless, androgynous, without pupils, dressed poorly, and completely monochrome. None of them reacted even to physical contact, walking in a [sic] "…zombie-like…" fashion and entering their respective homes. Subject entered one's house and encountered a total lack of resistance or decor, only a pipe and a single bowl below it, the humans laying down on the floor to sleep.

Each day, humans of this shift would perform manual labor for 14 hours, return home to eat, often bearing untreated cuts and bruises, then sleep for 8 hours. Subject found food in this reality was a grey, odorless sludge, dispensed from the pipe once a day. After two days waiting to see if something changes, subject noticed one of the humans looking at him for a moment.

The day afterwards, the human who looked did not go to work, instead sitting with subject. The human could not speak, and apparently had no teeth, both removed artificially. Tracing images in the dust on the floor, a rudimentary conversation could occur. In this reality, all humans were surgically made equal at birth, save for a group of apparent overlords who solely benefitted from the labor of the equalized ones. This human felt looking at subject made it feel positive, unequal from the rest who had no positivity or negativity, and asked subject to leave.

Leaving, subject was stalked by a much larger, constantly-grinning human, revealed to be an enforcer for the society's overlords, who grabbed subject. The human who communicated with subject earlier saved subject by blinding the enforcer with a bowl full of dust and helping subject flee. Subject shifted back immediately after Enforcer returned and separated subject and human.

Requests: None. Subject became more eager to begin conversations with others afterwards.

B3C-8NW-K1Y

Retrieval: Uneventful

Description: Subject Manifested in a Reality that was relatively normal to this one in almost every way. When Subject returned to this Universe and was asked about this Reality Shift, Subject stated [sic] "Apparently that version of me in that other Universe was put into this Strange Machine by Dr. Clef, which caused the other me to gain control of his Abilities". While there, Both Subject's traveled to different Realities that Original Subject had been wanting to visit for awhile now. However, Original Subject Returned to this Reality after spending a good amount of time in all of them with itself in the other Universe.

Requests: To be put into the same Machine as it's other self. Denied.

P0O-9YH-3AD

Retrieval: Uneventful.

Description: Subject manifested into a restroom identical to the one in Site-██ while in the process of relieving himself. Subject was unaware of his shift until approximately 5 minutes later, where he realized that the roll of toilet paper in his stall had been replaced with a small cactus.

Subject then spent the next hour sitting on the toilet waiting for his shift to end. During this time, no less than 4 individuals knocked on the door of his stall, requesting him to "hurry up" and that they were "really, really hungry."

Requests: For a pack of paper napkins to be added to his equipment. Granted.

579-62C-E44

Retrieval: Subject manifested inside the office of Site-19 Director Tilda D. Moose wearing an unknown variant of Foundation Keter containment staff uniform. Director Moose was not on site at the time.

Subject's presence did not alert the autonomic security measures of the office. A subsequent investigation revealed that it was added to Director Moose's approved visitor list. The addition was timestamped to a date prior to Foundation discovery of the subject. It refused to explain this impossibility during interrogation.

Description: [DATA RESTRICTED]

Requests: To speak with a member of the O5 Council. Initially denied. Subject was to be taken for immediate amnesticization, at which point it told the interrogating researcher that [DATA RESTRICTED]. Request was granted. It spoke with O5-█ on a secure landline for a period of 17 minutes. Afterwards it willingly surrendered itself to be amnesticized.

83R-ASQ-2I92

Retrieval: Recovered via tracking chip; found in the janitors closet of [REDACTED] Elementary School.

Description: Subject manifested in a barren landscape comprised of a red sky with no visible sun. Light was emitted dimly from the sky via an unknown source. Various burned shrubs and trees were scattered around, and various entities constructed out of charred human bones were present, patrolling aimlessly through the dimension. Once spotted, the instances gave chase to the subject while emitting cries similar to bells of various sizes and making ringing. Subject hid from and evaded these instances for an estimated thirteen hours, before being caught by an instance. The subject was then [REDACTED], resulting in serious lesions, bites, and burns. After an unknown amount of time being tortured by the instance, the subject demanifested back to our reality.

Requests: Medical attention, torture-withstantion classes, therapy. All granted.

PEN-239-I3P

Retrieval: Subject was recovered via tracking implant from an Applebee's restaurant. Subject had been bought a beer by another subject at the bar, which it was allowed to finish.

Description: Subject manifested on a large rock platform suspended over a seemingly endless void. It was observed by a massive red skeleton with flaming eyes, estimated to be over 400 feet in height, floating in the void over the platform. It began to chant in an unknown language as its head began spinning incredibly fast before rocketing off of the entity's spine and falling into the void. Subject demanifested after three hours.

Requests: N/A.

SOL-P01-F1R

Retrieval: Subject was recovered via tracking implant from the roof of Site-██. Subject was severely deafened, but hearing returned to normal after sixteen hours.

Description: Subject manifested in a large clearing surrounding by forest. It was nighttime. After sixteen minutes, the subject reportedly heard quiet screaming. As the sun began to rise, it was revealed to have a face on it displaying agony. It was constantly screaming at an estimated 90 decibels. Subject only demanifested once the day had ended and the night began again, which reportedly took over 42 hours.

Requests: Earmuffs to be added to its supplies. Denied. Earplugs to be added to its supplies. Granted.

Addendum 507-3B-00: Due to a particularly trying encounter with ███-███, several documents in the archives have been altered, corrupted, or technically-never-existed. Document 507-3B appears to have been affected by this, and is currently being rebuilt using backup files, references, and █████ respectively. Subject matter may occasionally increase, decrease, or undergo modifications in light of this. -Dr. ███

Footnotes
1. Subject submitted what it claimed was a drawing of the creature, but it was merely a wild mass of jagged lines.
2. Colloquially known as land sickness.
